name: Accountant

name: Candlestick Maker

name: Secret Paths
text: Noon Spirit 6: If this Spirit succeeds, this Shaman gains a +3 to his or her Shaman rating until after Nightfall.

name: Security Guard
text: Non-Unique. While the Security Guard is in a posse, effects that raise or lower hand ranks have no effect.

name: Seizing the Pearl of Death
text: Noon Kung-Fu Power: Target one of your unbooted Kung-Fu Dudes. Until the end of the game, the Dude has the ability: “Reaction: Boot this Dude after you reveal Draw hands in a shootout and this Dude is in your posse. Your posse suffers one less casualty.” Ace this card.

name: Shady Jake's
text: Public. Casino. Controller Noon: All players must place 1 ghost rock (if able) on this Deed. At the end of Nightfall, the current controller gains the ghost rock on the Deed. If this Deed leaves play, return the ghost rock to the bank.

name: Shi Kuan
text: Harrowed. Kung-Fu.

name: Shouting Tom's Tunnel
text: Private. Strike. Controller Reaction: Boot this Strike immediately before the Upkeep phase. If you do not have any ghost rock in your Vault, gain 3 ghost rock.

name: Silver Wolf
text: Silver Wolf has a +1 Influence bonus for each other unbooted Shaman at his location.

name: Silver-Tongued Devil
text: Noon Hex X: Declare a number from 1 to 5. X is three times the declared number. If this hex succeeds, this Huckster gains an Influence bonus equal to the number until after Nightfall, and this Hex is aced. If this Hex fails, this Huckster loses one Influence permanently (minimum 0).

name: Sister Leila
text: Sister Leila gains a +1 Bullet bonus and a +1 Influence bonus for each Mystical Goods she has attached.

name: Smiling Lizard Lode
text: Experienced. Private. Strike. Any Dude that is not a Terror has a -1 Bullet penalty (minimum 0) while in a shootout at this location. Controller Noon: Ace this Deed to discard all Dudes at this Deed.

name: Solomon
text: Noon: Boot Solomon to draw a card and add it to your Play hand.

name: Spirit Bond
text: Noon: Target two of your Dudes at the same location. Until after Nightfall, and while they are at a different location from each other, the Dudes gain a +1 Influence bonus and have their Value increased by 3.

name: Sprinkler System
text: You must boot a Mad Scientist to put this card into play. Owner Reaction: Play immediately before this Deed is aced. Ace this Improvement instead of this Deed.

name: Startin' Over
text: Players cannot gain ghost rock during High Noon this turn.

name: Step Back to Ward Off Monkey
text: Noon Kung-Fu Power: Target one of your unbooted Kung-Fu Dudes. Until the end of the game, the Dude has the ability: “Shootout: Move this Dude home, booted.” Ace this card.

name: Steve Elfinbein
text: While you have Steve in play, any time a Joker is part of your final Draw hand during a shootout, your hand rank is increased by 1 rank and is considered the worst possible hand of that rank. If you ever lose a round of a shootout, Steve is discarded from play.

name: Strike Experiment #3.1
text: Private. Strike. The Production of this Strike is equal to the highest Mad Scientist rating in play.

name: Tabitha
text: Abomination. Cannot attach Goods. “Tabitha” may only enter play if the Fear level is above 5. Shootout: Play when Tabitha is the only Dude in your posse. She becomes a Stud and gains a +2 Bullet bonus until the end of the shootout.

name: Tai Ch'i Technique
text: Noon Kung-Fu Power: Target one of your unbooted Kung-Fu Dudes. Until the end of the game, the Dude has the card text: “Card effects cannot ace this Dude. This will not prevent a Dude from being aced as a result of a shootout.” Ace this card.

name: Teresa Howe
text: Teresa gains a +3 bonus to her Blessed skill while in a shootout.

name: The 37th Chamber
text: Non-Unique. Kung Fu.

name: The Amazing Xemo
text: Experienced. Reaction: Boot Xemo before you draw your Draw hand during the Gambling phase. If the top card of your discard pile is an Event, put it on top of your deck.

name: The Ancients
text: Non-Unique. The Ancients may boot to join a posse as if they were in an adjacent location.

name: The Bloodless
text: Non-Unique. The Bloodless may not call out other Dudes.

name: The Claw
text: Gadget Difficulty: 6. Shootout: Target a Dude in the opposing posse. The Dude is sent home, booted.

name: The Damacles
text: Unique. Horse. Gadget Difficulty: 7 Can only be put into play by a Collegium player. Attaches to Fineas von Landingham without cost. Shootout: Boot the Damacles to move this Dude and any number of your other Dudes in this location into the current shootout, or out of the shootout, booted.

name: The Gauntlet
text: Noon: Boot one of your Dudes with the Kung-Fu trait to target another of your Dudes in the same location with a lower Value. Boot the target Dude. Until the end of the game that Dude has the Kung-Fu trait. Ace this card.

name: The Last Kingdom
text: Until after Nightfall, the Fear level is increased by 2, and all Dudes with Huckster, Blessed, Shaman and Mad Scientist skills gain a +2 bonus to their skill.

name: The Lurking Fear
text: Spells targeting the Lurking Fear have their difficulty increased by 4.

name: The Master's Dojo
text: Private. Controller Noon: Boot this Deed and target one of your Kung-Fu Dudes. The Dude gains a +1 Bullet bonus until after Nightfall for each Kung-Fu Power he has. Controller Shootout: Boot this Deed and target one of your Kung-Fu Dudes in this shootout. The Dude gains a +1 Bullet bonus until the end of the shootout for each Kung-Fu Power he has.

name: The Quarantine Ends!
text: Until after Nightfall, no player may win the game unless he or she has the most (or tied for the most) total bullets in play. Ace this card.

name: The Sky is Falling
text: Until after Nightfall, actions printed on Dudes may not be used.

name: The Swarm
text: Non-Unique. May not move to in-town Deeds. The Swarm can only be put into play by a Maze Rats player. Noon: Move this Dude to a Strike.

name: The Troupe
text: Controller Noon: Target a Spell attached to one of your Dudes that has been used this turn. The Spell may not be used again this turn. The Dude that has the Spell attached becomes Wanted and the Spell is aced after Nightfall if still in play.

name: The Undermaze
text: Private. Strike.

name: Theodore White
text: Theodore may only create Horse Gadgets.

name: Timmy Derrick
text: Experienced. Only Terrors can call out Timmy. Shootout Pull: Target a Dude in the opposing posse. If the pull plus Timmy’s Value is greater than the Dude’s Value, the Dude is a Draw and has his or her Bullet rating reduced to 0 until the end of the shootout.

name: Tucker Hastings
text: Tucker has +1 Production while he is in a Saloon. Noon: Play when Tucker is in a Saloon. Target another Dude in the Saloon to move that Dude to the Town Square, booted.

name: Turnabout's Fair Play!
text: Reaction: Play when a player receives ghost rock as a result of a card effect. The player does not gain the ghost rock, and must pay that amount to the Bank instead, up to the total amount in his or her Vault.

name: Unearthly Beacon
text: Noon Hex 8: Boot this Huckster to target a Dude in your discard pile. If this Hex is successful, put the target into play, normally. The target’s ghost rock cost is reduced by the Huckster’s skill.

name: Union Withdrawal
text: All Drifters and all Dudes controlled by outfits of a different faction than their controller have their Values reduced by 5 (minimum A) until after Nightfall.

name: Vampiric Dance Hall Girl
text: Abomination. For each dude that is aced at the same location, the Vampiric Dance Hall Girl gains +1 Bullet until after Nightfall.

name: Victory Springs
text: Private. During each round of a shootout at this location, the losing posse suffers one additional casualty.

name: Vigilance Ranch
text: Private. Out of Town. Harrowed Dudes and Hucksters have +2 Influence for the purposes of controlling this Deed.

name: Watch the Floor…
text: Noon: Target a location you control. The next time one or more Dudes move to the target location, each Dude must pull: If the pull is greater than the Dude’s Value, the Dude is sent home booted. If the pull is greater than the Value plus 5, the Dude is aced. This action has no cost if J.P. Coleman is at the target location.

name: Water Lou's
text: Non-Unique. Public. Saloon. Any Dude aced while at Water Lou's is removed from play permanently. No other copy of that Dude may enter play for the rest of the game.

name: Watering Trough
text: Controller Noon: Target a Horse at this Deed. The Horse is unbooted, and actions on the Horse may be used an additional time this turn.

name: What's That Ticking?
text: Reaction: Target a Dude immediately after he or she moves to a Deed you control and have at least one Dude at. Send all of your Dudes at the Deed home booted. The target’s controller must Pull: If the Pull is greater than the target’s Value, he or she is aced.

name: Whateleys: Black Circle
text: GR: 19 Reaction: When one of your Dudes is targeted with an action, ace a Spell attached to one of your Dudes to cancel the action.

name: Widow Withers
text: Non-Unique. Only Hucksters may call out the Widow Withers.

name: Wild Dingos
text: Sidekick. Noon: Target a Dude in this location. Boot Wild Dingos to call out the target Dude, who cannot refuse. Reaction: Perform immediately after Draw hands are compared in a shootout and you have lost the round. Ace Wild Dingos to reduce your casualties by 2. The attached Dude gains a +2 Bullet bonus and is a Stud for the next round of the shootout.

name: William Rose
text: Experienced. Noon: Call out a Dude at this location. You may only use this action if William is Wanted.

name: Windows Derek
text: Experienced. Reaction: When a player targets another one of your Dudes in this location with an action, boot Windows to cancel the action.

name: Wing Chun Technique
text: Noon Kung-Fu Power: Target one of your unbooted Kung-Fu Dudes. Until the end of the game, the Dude has the ability: “Reaction: Play after this Dude’s posse wins a round of a shootout. This Dude gains a +2 Bullet bonus until the end of the shootout, and the opposing posse may not chicken out of this shootout.” Ace this card.

name: Yankee Pride
text: Noon: Give an Agency Dude a +1 Bullet, +1 Influence, or +3 value (maximum King) until after Nightfall.

name: You Goin' Somewhere?
text: Reaction: Play when a Dude moves out of a location. Boot one of your Dudes at the same location to cancel the move. Any costs of the move (such as booting) remain paid.

name: You Lookin' For This?
text: Noon: Target a Deed. Boot all Dudes at the Deed with 0 Influence.

name: Yung Kim
text: Yung Kim gains a +3 bonus to his Mad Scientist skill while creating a Gadget Horse.

name: Zombie Miners
text: Non-Unique. Abomination. The Upkeep cost of Zombie Miners is reduced by 1 (minimum 0) while controlled by a Maze Rats player. While the Zombie Miners are at a Strike you control, the Strike’s production is increased by +2.

name: or After Three?
text: Shootout: Play when the number of Dudes in the opposing posse exceeds the number of Dudes in your posse by 2 or more. Your opponent’s Draw hand in this shootout round is reduced by 2 ranks (and is considered the best hand of that rank).

name: Benjamin Nightsinger
text: Shootout: +1 bullet bonus if there is a terror in the opposing posse. Benjamin can do this once in every shootout he is in.

name: Bounty Hunter
text: Noon: Target a Wanted Dude. A Bounty Hunter enters play at the Dude's location and calls out the Dude, who cannot refuse. The Bounty Hunter is a 2-Stud, 0 Influence, ace value token Dude. Remove the token Dude from play after the shootout.

name: Bow and Arrow
text: May only be held by a Sioux. Shootout Pull: Boot this dude and the Bow and Arrow, target an opposing dude. If the Pull is greater than the target's value plus his bullet rating, then Ace the target.

name: Calming Spirits
text: Noon Spirit X: The difficulty of this spirit is equal to the current Fear Level plus the number of Terrors in play. If the spirit is successful, the Fear Level is reduced by one and this spirit is sent to your discard pile.

name: Corporeal Twist
text: Shootout Hex 5: If the hex is successful, one opposing dude has his bullets reduced by two for this shootout. Shootout Hex 9: If the hex is successful, one opposing dude has his bullets reduced to zero for this shootout.

name: Curse
text: Noon Spirit 6: If the Spirit is successful, one dude in play has a -1 Bullet and -1 Influence penalty until after nightfall. Noon Spirit 10: If the Spirit is successful, one dude in play has a -2 Bullet and -2 Influence penalty until after nightfall.

name: Danny Hamilton
text: Noon: Move Hamilton to any location that has an Abomination in it. This does not boot Hamilton.

name: Deadland
text: Non-Unique. Public. If the Fear level is 6 or higher, the cost of the Deadland is 0. Subsequent Deadlands cannot be played unless the Fear level is at least 1 higher than its current level. Controller Reaction: Immediately before you put a Terror into play, boot the Deadland to gain 5 ghost rock. You can use that ghost rock to pay for the Terror.

name: Double Time
text: Noon: Boot one of your dudes. The deed your dude is in has its ghost rock production doubled during the next upkeep phase.

name: Elizabeth King
text: Reaction: Boot Elizabeth to reduce by 2 ghost rock the cost of a non-terror drifter you are about to bring into play.

name: Fish Ridge Mine
text: Private. Strike.

name: Hat Gun
text: Shootout: Attach this card as a Goods card to your Mad Scientist in this shootout. This card acts as a goods card and is a +1 Bullet weapon Gadget (with no difficulty).

name: Hot Lead Flyin'
text: Reaction Pull: Play immediately after hands are revealed in a shootout. For each dude the losing posse has with a value higher than the pull, the winner must ace a dude in his posse as if he had lost the round.

name: Human Shield
text: Shootout: One of your dudes in this shootout becomes wanted. This dude cannot be aced in this round of the shootout. Continue the shootout if necessary.

name: Ian Spencer-Whitney
text: Shootout: Gains a +3 bullet bonus, but cannot use (or have used) any weapons in this shootout. Ian may only use this ability if there is one or more Terrors in the opposing posse.

name: Icehouse
text: Controller Reaction: Boot immediately after a dude is aced to put him on ice instead of burying him (This aces any dude currently in the Icehouse). This dude is dead, but not at Boot Hill and only the controller of the Icehouse can target this dude.

name: John Bloody Knife
text: Shootout: Replace Joseph Eyes-Like-Rain in a posse that John is not in. Joseph goes to your home, booted.

name: Joseph Eyes-Like-Rain
text: Reaction: Boot Joseph when you have just discarded a Draw hand. Take any one card from the Draw hand and place it in your Play hand. Discard a card if you have more than five.

name: Labor Dispute
text: All Strikes have their printed Production reduced by 2 this turn (minimum 0).

name: Lawrence Goodman
text: Noon: One of your other dudes at another location begins a job at the deed Goodman is in. If the job is successful and this deed is in town, take ghost rock from the deed's owner equal to the bullet rating of the dude performing the deed.

name: Lightning Strike
text: Shootout Spirit X: The difficulty of this spirit is an opposing Dude's Value plus Bullets. If this spirit is successful, the target is booted and sent home. If the Spirit is successful by more than 5 points, the target is aced as well. If you pull an ace or Joker, the shaman is also aced.

name: Little Running Bear
text: Shootout: When in a shootout against a Terror, raise Bear's bullet rating to be equal to the lowest rating among opposing Terrors.

name: Medicine
text: Reaction Spirit X: When a Dude is aced, boot this Shaman. X is the target Dude's value plus Influence plus Bullet rating. If the Spirit succeeds, the Dude is not aced, but is sent home booted.

name: New Science Magazine
text: The new issue arrived! Get any one Gadget from your deck, show it to the other players, and add it to your hand. Take any one card from your hand and shuffle it back into your deck.

name: On the Side Strike
text: Private. Strike.

name: Pembroke's Analysis of Hoyle
text: Mystical. Play only on a Huckster. This Huckster has his huckster level increased by 2. Reaction: When this dude's opponent in a shootout reveals an illegal Draw hand, target one dude in the opposing posse who is aced immediately, before the results of the shootout are determined.

name: Reserves
text: Noon: Gain 1 ghost rock.

name: Rumors
text: Noon: Target a Dude. Until after Nightfall, the Dude has a -1 Influence penalty while at any location except home.

name: Shadow Man
text: Noon Hex 5: If this hex is successful, this huckster cannot be targeted by other players' actions until after nightfall.

name: Singing Feather
text: Reaction: Boot Singing Feather to cancel any action about to be taken by a Harrowed dude.

name: Sioux Union
text: GR: 18 Reaction: Instead of receiving your home's production during upkeep, you may get any one spirit or Sioux dude from your deck, show it to your opponents and put it in your hand. If you borrowed from the Bank during the Gambling Phase, you must be able to repay that ghost rock in order to use this action.

name: Snakebite
text: Cheatin'! Reaction: Play when another player reveals an illegal Draw hand during a shootout. Target and ace a Dude in the opposing posse. Only one Cheatin'! card can be played against a player per draw.

name: Strength of the Bear
text: Shootout Spirit 4: If this spirit is successful, target one of your dudes in this shootout who then cannot be aced in this shootout unless you lose by at least 2 ranks. Shootout Spirit 7: If this spirit is successful, target one of your dudes in this shootout who then cannot be aced in this shootout unless you lose by at least 3 ranks.

name: Take Ya With Me
text: Reaction: Play immediately after casualties are aced during a shootout. The winner of this round must target and ace one Dude in his or her posse, unless all the Dudes in that posse have Bullet ratings higher than the Bullet ratings of all the casualties aced by the losing player.

name: The 1st Bank is Robbed!
text: Choose one deed in play. For this turn, that deed does not produce ghost rock for its owner, but instead has upkeep equal to its normal production.

name: The Amazing Xemo
text: Noon: Look at one random card in each of your opponent's hands.

name: Throw Down
text: Noon: Boot one of your dudes to call out any dude at the same location that has a lower value. They begin a shootout that can't be refused.

name: Tioga Joe
text: Tioga Joe cannot be aced in a shootout unless your hand is beaten by at least two ranks.

name: Total Eclipse
text: Until nightfall two turns after this one, flushes are no longer a legal poker hand. (Straights and full houses are still two ranks apart). Ace this card.

name: Walkin' Dead
text: Abomination. The Walkin' Dead cannot move to Strikes. Any Dude in a posse with the Walkin' Dead immediately becomes Wanted. There is no limit to the number of Walkin' Dead that each player can have in play. Card Memory does not apply to Walkin' Dead.

name: War Paint
text: Noon: Target one of your Dudes. The Dude gains a +2 Bullet bonus until after Nightfall.

name: Water's Edge Strike
text: Private. Strike.

name: Weaponsmith
text: Private. Controller Noon: Boot one of your Dudes at this location. One Weapon carried by the dude has a +1Bullet bonus until the end of the game even if it has no Bullet rating. Each weapon can only be modified once in this fashion.

name: Whiskey Nick
text: Shootout: Nick gains a +1 Bullet stud bonus when there is one or more Maze Rats in the opposing posse.

name: Apache Devil Dancers
text: Reaction Spirit 6: Immediately before an Event in a lowball Draw hand resolves, boot this Shaman. If this Spirit succeeds, the Event is discarded without effect. Reaction Spirit 8: Immediately before an Event in a lowball Draw hand resolves, boot this Shaman. If this Spirit succeeds, the Event is aced without effect.

name: Ask the Spirits
text: Noon Spirit 8: If this spirit is successful, you may immediately play an event from your hand and resolve it's effects as a noon action.

name: Billy Iron Horse
text: Noon: Boot Billy and discard up to three cards from your hand. Draw a number of cards equal to the number you discarded.

name: Bobo LeVeux
text: Reaction: Boot Bobo immediately before a hex pull is made by a dude with a lower huckster rating than Bobo. The hex is automatically unsuccessful.

name: Cheyenne Bottoms
text: Noon: Boot Bottoms and discard any number of cards. Bottoms loses one value for each card as it is discarded. Bottoms is aced if his value is ever an ace (or lower).

name: Chrono Accelerator
text: Gadget Difficulty: 8. Noon: Boot this gadget. You may immediately perform 2 additional noon actions before the next player's turn.

name: Death's Head Joker
text: This card can only be used for shootout Draw hands. Ace this card after it is used. If it is pulled, or revealed in a non-shootout Draw hand, it has no effect - immediately ace and replace it with the top card of your deck. When used in a shootout Draw hand, it is a Wildcard: the player who draws it determines its suit and value, and in addition, the lowest value Dude (or Dudes) in the opposing posse is aced before hand ranks are compared. You cannot have more than two Jokers in a deck. This card does not count against your deck limit.

name: Den of Eastern Delights
text: Non-Unique. Public. Owner Reaction: Immediately before an Event resolves, boot the Den to cancel the Event without effect. The Event is aced.

name: Derringer
text: Shootout: One of your dudes in this gunfight has a Derringer. Attach this card to your dude. This card acts in all ways as if it were a +1 Bullet weapon good card. The Derringer can only be chosen as a weapon for one round of a Shootout per turn.

name: Envy
text: Shootout: Target one dude. That dude may not be the shooter during this Shootout, if another dude is available.

name: Father Juan Navarro
text: Experienced. Father Juan may not boot to perform the Blackjack Outfit's ability. Hexes and Spirits cannot target Father Juan.

name: Flophouse
text: The Flophouse's controller may bring dude's into play at the Flophouse instead of at home.

name: Friendly Game
text: Noon: Boot one of your dudes who begins gambling with any non terror dude at the same location. Each player draws a draw hand, and the winner takes ghost rock equal to the difference between hands from the loser (up to the loser's entire stockpile of ghost rock).

name: Hired Guns
text: Noon: Get any one dude from your discard pile and put it in your hand.

name: Holdout Knife
text: Reaction Pull: Ace the Knife immediately when this dude is aced in a Shootout. Target one dude in the opposing posse. If the pull is equal to or greater than the target's value, the target is aced.

name: Hoyle's Book, 1769 Ed.
text: Mystical. Noon: Target any hex in play. The Book is considered to be an exact copy of that spell until after nightfall.

name: Jack Guns Down Spike
text: Until after nightfall, any action cards played from a player's hand are aced. Ace Spike Dugan. Ace this card.

name: Kansas City Kara
text: Lycanthrope. Noon Pull: If the pull is red, put the Werewolf into play in this location. Put Kara into your hand with all of her goods. If a Full Moon has been played this turn, the pull is automatically red and cannot be changed from red in any way.

name: Katie Karl
text: Any dude you are bringing into play has his or her cost reduced by their bullet rating while Katie is in play.

name: Little Running Bear
text: Experienced. Noon: Boot Bear to move him to any location with a Terror and begin a shootout between Bear and the Terror. No other dudes may join.

name: Marked Cards
text: Shootout: Your opponent's draw hand is played face up on the table for this shootout. Your Draw Hand is automatically considered an illegal hand, regardless of its contents.

name: Massacre at High Noon
text: Noon Job: Boot one of your Dudes to start a job that targets a location. Unbooted Dudes can always join the target's posse from any location, ignoring movement restrictions. Before Shootout actions begin each round, all Dudes can pay 3 ghost rock to leave the shootout and move to an adjacent location, booted. If the job succeeds, your posse goes home, and all Dudes remaining at the location are aced. You cannot play this on the first turn of the game.

name: Mimic
text: Reaction: Play immediately after a dude is aced in a Shootout. Any one Harrowed dude at that Shootout permanently gains any one action printed on the aced dude.

name: Nicodemus Whateley
text: Experienced. You can ignore the upkeep cost of one Abomination you control, each turn. Noon Pull: Target one hex attached to Nicodemus. Nicodemus can use that hex two times this turn. If the pull is greater than the hex's value, it is aced immediately after nightfall.

name: Nicodemus' Deck
text: Mystical.. The Deck can be attached to Nicodemus Whateley without cost. This dude's Huckster skill is increased by one while the Deck is attached. This will not give the Huckster skill to a Dude without the skill.

name: Puppet
text: Noon Hex X: Target a Dude at this location. X is the Dude's value plus Influence plus Bullet rating. If this Hex succeeds, you take control of the Dude until after Nightfall.

name: Quick-draw Holster
text: When this dude is the shooter in a Shootout, your hand is considered one rank higher (but considered the worst hand of that rank). Multiple Quick-draw holsters are not cumulative.

name: Rails Richardson
text: Noon: Move Rails and one other of your dudes at this location from one strike to another. This does not boot Rails or your other dude.

name: Repel Manitou
text: Noon Spirit X: The difficulty of this Spirit is the value of a Terror in this Shaman's location. If this Spirit is successful, the Terror is moved to a location of your choice, without booting.

name: Reverend Simon MacPherson
text: Experienced. Harrowed dudes may not call MacPherson out. Shootout: Boot MacPherson to ace one Terror in this shootout.

name: Robert Northrop
text: Experienced. Harrowed. While Robert is unbooted and at a Strike, the printed Production of the Strike is doubled. Reaction: When a Strike is aced, boot Robert and move him to the Strike if he is not already there. The Strike is no longer aced.

name: Sacrifice
text: Noon Miracle 6: Boot this Blessed and target a booted Dude in play. If this Miracle is successful, unboot the Dude.

name: Spike Kills Eureka
text: During nightfall this turn, dudes in their homes have their influence reduced by one. If "Eureka!" is in play, it is sent to the card owner's Boot Hill. Ace this card. This card does not affect "Eureka?!?".

name: Spirit Warrior
text: Noon Spirit 3: Target a Sioux Dude. If this Spirit succeeds, the Dude gains a +1 Bullet bonus until after Nightfall. Noon Spirit 7: Target a Sioux Dude. If this Spirit succeeds, the Dude gains a +2 Bullet bonus until after Nightfall.

name: Stoker's Sabre
text: Mystical. The Sabre can be attached to Austin Stoker without cost. This dude has a +1 Bullet bonus, a +1 Influence and a Huckster: 1 skill (or a +1 to his or her Huckster skill) while the Sabre is attached.

name: Strike Experiment #1
text: Private. Strike.

name: Summon Spirit
text: Shootout Spirit 6: If this Spirit succeeds, a Spirit joins your posse. The Spirit is a 1 Draw, 0 Influence, ace-value token Dude. The Spirit is removed from play after the shootout. Shootout Spirit 9: If this Spirit succeeds, a Spirit joins your posse. The Spirit is a 2 Stud, 0 Influence, ace-value token Dude. The Spirit is removed from play after the shootout.

name: Take Cover
text: Shootout: Target one of your dudes. That dude cannot be aced in this round of the Shootout unless your hand is beaten by at least three ranks. Continue the Shootout if necessary. Your dude is a -1 Bullet for this round of the shootout.

name: Tent City (Chinese Workers)
text: Tent City's cost is reduced by 2 if you have Captain Sim Yut-San in play.

name: That's Two Pair
text: Reaction: Play immediately after a player reveals a Draw Hand that is a Dead Man's Hand. That hand is considered to be just Two Pair (aces and eights) instead of a Dead Man's Hand.

name: The Bathhouse
text: Dudes in the Bathhouse cannot be targeted by action cards or by actions from dudes that are not in this location.

name: The Mission House
text: Public. Out of Town. Holy Ground. Terrors cannot move to the Mission House or call out a Dude in it.

name: The Texas Rangers
text: GR: 19 Noon: Target a Terror. Boot one of your Dudes in the same or adjacent location to call out the Terror. Reaction: Immediately before one of your Dudes moves or joins a posse, boot this card. The Dude can ignore all movement restrictions, and can join a posse at a non-adjacent location. All movement costs, such as booting, must still be paid.

name: Town Well
text: Public.

name: Unholy Symbol
text: Mystical. If this Dude is in a posse that wins a round of a shootout, the opposing posse takes one additional casualty.

name: Yellow Traitor

text: Noon: During Nightfall this turn, players do not count Victory Points when checking the victory condition.

name: What This Town Needs Is…
text: Noon: Get any Deed or Improvement from your deck or discard pile, show it to your opponents, and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck if you look through it for the Deed

name: Whateley Family Bible
text: Unique. Mystical. The Whateley Family Bible has no ghost rock cost if being attached to Wilhelmina Whateley. Terrors at this Dude's location (including this Dude if he or she is a Terror) gain a +1 Bullet bonus, a +1 Influence bonus, and a +1 bonus to each skill.

name: Wilhelmina Whateley
text: Experienced. Huckster: 3  Lower each of your Terrors' Upkeep costs by 1 (minimum 0).  Shootout: Ace one of your Dudes. Target an opposing Dude with a Bullet rating less than that of the Dude you aced. Ace the target Dude.

name: Wise Cloud
text: Experienced.

name: Wither
text: Noon Harrowed Power: Target one of your unbooted Harrowed Dudes. Until the end of the game, the Dude has the ability "Noon: Boot this Dude. Target a Dude in this or an adjacent location. The target's controller pulls three times: if all three pulls exceed the target's value, ace the target Dude." Ace this card.

name: Worse'n I Thought
text: Reaction: Play this card when a Dude being aced is no longer aced due to a card effect. Cancel the effect and ace the Dude normally.

name: Wrath
text: Experienced.  Shootout: All opposing Dudes are considered to have blank text boxes until after the shootout ends.

name: Zapper
text: Weapon. Gadget Difficulty: 5. Shootout: Target an opposing Dude. Until the shootout ends, the target Dude cannot be the shooter if another Dude can be, and the target Dude's Bullet rating does not contribute to the number of cards drawn or redrawn by the opposing player.

name: Abel Owens
text: Experienced. Noon: Target a Dude at this location with one or more Spells attached. Abel calls out the Dude.

name: Abomination Pit
text: While there is at least one Terror at this location, the Fear level is increased by 1 (maximum 10).

name: Agoraphobia
text: Noon: Target a Dude in play. The Dude has a -2 Bullet penalty (minimum 0) and a -2 Influence penalty (minimum 0) until after Nightfall while in the Town Square.

name: All God's Children
text: All Deeds with "Church", "Chapel", or "Mission" in their title have their Production increased by +2 and are worth 1 additional Control Point, until after Nightfall.

name: Ammunitionist
text: Private. Controller Noon: Boot this Deed to target a Bullet card in your Boot Hill. Move that card to your discard pile. Controller Noon: Boot this Deed to target a Bullet card in your discard pile. Shuffle that card into your deck.

name: Andrew Garret
text: Reaction: Use when another player declares the target of a job. You may unboot up to two of your Dudes that are at or adjcent to the target's location.

name: Animate Hand
text: Abomination. There is no limit to the number of Animate Hands that each player may have in play. Animate Hands cannot attach Goods. Card memory does not apply to Animate Hands. Any Dudes with higher Values in a posse opposing an Animate Hand have the ability - Shootout: Boot this Dude to ace an Animate Hand in the opposing posse. Reduce this Dude's Bullet rating to 0 until the end of the shootout.

name: April Segarra
text: When April calls out a Wanted dude, that dude may not refuse.

name: Auxiliumortis
text: Select a Terror in play. The Terror is booted and may not be targeted with actions this turn.

text: Shootout Hex X: Target a Dude in the opposing posse. X is the Value of the Dude. If the Hex succeeds, the Dude's text box is blank until the end of this shootout.

name: Barney Brash
text: Barney may not create non-Weapon Gadgets. If Barney has a Weapon Gadget ready, he does not need to boot to join a posse in an adjacent location.

name: Between the Cracks
text: Reaction: Play when one of your Dudes is called out. Your Dude refuses the call out and must move to an adjacent location. If your Dude is not Wanted, the Dude who called your Dude out becomes Wanted.

name: Bioengineering
text: Unique. Gadget Difficulty: 9 Noon Pull: Target a Dude in play and make a skill check using this Dude's Mad Scientist skill (if any). If the skill check exceeds the target Dude's Value, all copies of the target become non-Unique and players may have any number of that Dude in play. Card memory does not apply to copies of that Dude. These changes are permanent.

name: Bites the Hand
text: Bites the Hand may not attach Goods cards that can only be attached to Sioux Dudes.

name: Blackjacks: Rachel's Gang
text: GR: 18 Noon: Boot this Outfit and pay 2 ghost rock to get a Job Action card from your deck, show it to the other players, and add it to your Play hand. Discard a card from your Play hand and shuffle your deck.

name: Blasted Prairie
text: Private. Out of Town. Controller Noon: Target a skilled Dude at this location. That Dude's skill is doubled for his or her next Skill Check this turn. After that Skill Check, the Dude loses the skill until after Nightfall.

name: Bloodsport Arena
text: Private. Control of the Arena is determined using Bullet ratings instead of Influence. Controller Noon: Target two Dudes at this location controlled by different players. Those Dudes start a shootout which other Dudes cannot join. All cards attached to those Dudes are considered blank until the end of the shootout.

name: Breath of the Spirits
text: Noon Spirit 6: Target one of your booted Dudes. If this Spirit succeeds, boot this Shaman to unboot the target Dude.

name: Brimstone Bullets
text: Bullet. Shootout: Target a Wanted Dude in the opposing posse. Ace the Brimstone Bullets to ace the target Dude.

name: Bring It Down!
text: Noon Harrowed Power: Target one of your unbooted Harrowed Dude. Until the end of the game, the Dude has the ability: "Noon: Target a Dude in this location with a lower Value and move the Dude to his or her home. That Dude may not move to this location until after Nightfall. Ace this card.

name: Brush With Death
text: Noon Miracle 9: Target a Dude in Boot Hill. If this Miracle succeeds, move that Dude to his or her owner's discard pile.

name: Cadaverus Mobilis
text: Once this turn, as a Noon action, youi may unboot one Terror in play. Ace this card.

name: Cain Regen
text: Experienced. Shootout: Target a Draw Dude in Cain's Posse with the Blessed or Huckster skill. The Dude is a Stud until after Nightfall.

name: Channel Fort
text: Private. Government. Texas Rangers Dudes may not move to this Location. The ghost rock cost to bring this Deed into play is reduced by 2 if you are an Agency player.

name: Charlie Landers
text: Experienced. Charlie cannot be called out or move to a location you do not control. While Charlie is in a Saloon, that Saloon gains a +1 Control Point bonus.

name: Chip
text: A Dude may only have one "Chip" attached. This Dude may not refuse a call out.

name: Claustrophobia
text: Noon: Target a Dude in play. The Dude has a -1 Bullet penalty (minimum 0) and a -1 Influence penalty (minimum 0) until after Nightfall while at an in-town Deed or their Home.

name: Clean Getaway
text: Reaction: Play immediately before one of your Dudes becomes Wanted. Move the Dude to an out-of-town location, and the Dude no longer becomes Wanted.

name: Clovis the Devilbunny
text: Mystical. Reaction: Boot the Devilbunny when this Dude is aced. If you are the Winner, the Dude is not aced, but is sent home booted instead. This Dude does not unboot during Nightfall this turn.

name: Confessional
text: Public. Holy Ground. Wanted Dues are not considered Wanted while at this location.

name: Construction Crew
text: Noon Job: Boot one of your Dudes to start a job that targets the Town Square. Any player may defend the job, starting with the Winner and going clockwise. Before posses are formed, select an in-town Deed with a ghost rock cost less than 7 and show it to the other players. If the job succeeds, put the Deed into play with no ghost rock cost. If the job fails, put the Deed into Boot Hill.

name: Darren Titus
text: Experienced Darren's Influence cannot be greater than 1 while at home. Noon: Give Darren an Influence bonus up to the number of your Dudes in this location. Darren's Upkeep cost is increased by an equal amount. The Influence bonus lasts until after Nightfall this turn, and the increased Upkeep cost lasts until after Nightfall next turn.

name: David Hope
text: Noon: Reduce David's Value by 2 permanently. David gains +3 to his Blessed skill until after Nightfall. If David's Value is less than 2, he is aced.

name: Deep in the Earth Shaft
text: Private. Strike. Controller Reaction: Immediately after a Dude at this location is aced, increase the Production of this Deed by 1, permanently.

name: Deputy Tophet
text: Noon: Target a Dude with a Spell or Mystical Goods card attached. That Dude becomes Wanted until after Nightfall.

name: Desperate Measures
text: Reaction: Play when another player brings a Dude from a different Outfit into play. Increase the Upkeep cost of that Dude by 3 until after Nightfall next turn.

name: Distracted!
text: Reaction: Play after a Spell resolves. Ace the Spell.

name: Divided Loyalties
text: Cheatin'! Reaction: Play when another player reveals an illegal Draw hand. Target a Dude controlled by that player whose Value is less than the illegal Draw hand's rank plus 4. name: Doctor Duvalier
text: Experienced.

name: Doctor Hardstrom
text: Reaction Pull: Boot Dr. Hardstrom when you bring a Terror into play. If the pull is less than the Terror's Value, the Terror gains a permanent +2 Bullet bonus.

name: Draw!
text: Shootout Miracle 4: If this Miracle succeeds, you may draw one additional card to make your Draw hand for this round of the shootout. Shootout Miracle 8: If this Miracle succeeds, you may draw two additional cards to make your Draw hand for this round of the shootout.

name: Eagle Bow
text: Unique. Mystical. Weapon. Noon: This Dude gains an Influence bonus or a Bullet bonus (you choose) equal to the number of your Shamen in Boot Hill, until after Nightfall.

name: Eagle Rock
text: Experienced-2. Shootout: Move Eagle Rock to the location of the shootout, ignoring movement restrictions. Eagle Rock joins your posse. Shootout: Target one of your other Dudes in this shootout. Move the Dude to another location that is out of town - the Dude is no longer in the shootout. This action may be used any number of times per turn.

name: Elephant Hill Mausoleum
text: Private. When the Mausoleum controller's Harrowed Dudes are aced, that player performs the Harrowed pull from his or her own deck.

name: Elijah
text: Experienced 2. Noon Job: Boot Elijah to start a job that target another player's Dude with a Mystical Goods card attached. If the job succeeds, the Dude and Goods card are aced (if still in play), and you gain 1 Victory Point.

name: Ethics Aside
text: Reaction Pull: Play when you fail a Gadget skill check. If the new Pull is red, the skill check succeeds and the Mad Scientist becomes wanted.

name: Evan Childes
text: Noon: Boot Evans to protect this location. Until after Nightfall, other players' Dudes with a lower Value than Evan's may not move to this location.

name: Exploratory Trench
text: Non-Unique. Private. Out-of-Town. The ghost rock cost of the Exploratory Trench is increased by 1 for each Exploratory Trench already in play.

name: Eyes That Cannot See
text: Reaction: Play when one of your Dudes is targeted with a Spell. If your Dude's Value is greater than the Value of the Dude casting the Spell, the Spell fails.

name: Father Terrance
text: Experienced. Reaction: Use when you bring a Blessed into play with a higher Blessed skill than Father Terrance. Boot Father Terrance to get any 3 cards from your deck. Shuffle your deck, then place those 3 cards on top of your deck in any order.

name: Faulty Pipes
text: Noon: Target a Saloon in play. Until after Nightfall next turn, that Deed's Control Points and Production are reduced to 0.

name: Faustian Deal
text: Noon Hex 10: Target one of your other Dudes in the same location as this Huckster. If the Hex succeeds, the target Dude gains the Skill: Huckster 1 and becomes a Stud until the end of the game. If the Hex fails, the target Dude is removed from play, and no other copies of the Dude may enter play for the rest of the game.

name: First to Fall
text: Reaction: Play immediately before you ace casualties in a shootout. Ace the highest Value Dude in your posse. Card effects cannot prevent this Dude from being aced or going to Boot Hill - Harrowed Dudes do not make a pull. The number of your casualties in this round of the shootout is reduced to zero.

name: Flashfire Bullets
text: Bullet. Shootout: Ace the Flashfire Bullets to send home all Dudes in the opposing posse who have a Value less than or equal to this Dude's Bullet rating.

name: Flight of Angels
text: Cheatin'! Reaction: Play when another player reveals an illegal Draw hand. Until the end of the game, whenever that player reveals an illegal Draw hand (including this one), that player must either make one of his or her un-Wanted Dudes Wanted, or ace one of his or her Wanted Dudes. Only one Cheatin! Card can be played against a player per draw.

name: Freak Show
text: Public. After each Upkeep Phase, the Freak Show's Production and Control Points are reduced by 1, permanently. If this Deed ever has a production of 0, it is removed from play and no other copies can be played for the rest of the game. Terrors have a +1 Influence bonus while at the Freak Show.

name: Get Off My Land!
text: Noon: Target one of your Dudes. Move the Dude to a location that you own, but do not control.

text: Shootout actions printed on Weapons attached to Ghost of My Father may be used twice per turn instead of once.

name: Giddyup!
text: Reaction: Play when one of your Dudes boots to join a posse. Your Dude does not boot to join the posse.

name: Gnosis
text: Non-Unique. Gnosis may only produce Mystical Gadgets.

name: Guy Fawkes Day
text: Starting with the Winner and going clockwise, each player may target one in-town Deed. Targeted Deeds have their text boxes blanked until after Nightfall (those Deeds are considered public). Ace this card.

name: Haborym
text: Harrowed.

text: Reaction: Play when posses are being formed for a Shootout. Boot one of your Dudes, regardless of location, to move him or her into your posse.

text: Shootout: Boot one of your Dudes in this shootout to draw cards into your Play hand equal to the Dude's Value minus 10 (minimum 0 and maximum 3. For example, booting a Queen would draw 2 cards).

name: Insult to Injury
text: Reaction: Play when your posse wins a round of a shootout. Your lead Shooter gains a +1 Influence bonus, permanently. Ace this card.

name: Interior Decorating
text: This Improvement may only be attached to an in-town Deed with production greater than zero.

name: It's For Her Own Good
text: Cheatin'! Reaction: Play when another player reveals an illegal Draw hand. Reduce that player's maximum hand size by 2 (minimum 0) until after Nightfall next turn. Only one Cheatin'! card can be played against a player per draw.

name: Jack Brash
text: Shootout: Boot Jack to target a Stud Dude in the opposing posse. The Dude becomes a Draw until the end of the shootout.

name: Jack Whateley
text: Reaction: Boot Jack immediately before Nightfall to target another player's Dude who is alone at an in-town location. Jack moves to that location and calls the Dude out to a shootout that cannot be refused. Jack gains a +2 Bullet bonus until after Nightfall.

name: Jam!
text: Cheatin'! Reaction: Play when another player reveals an illegal Draw hand. Target a Dude controlled by that player. Discard all cards attached to that Dude. Only one Cheatin'! card can be played against a player per draw.

name: Jenny Cooper
text: Experienced. Noon: Boot Jenny to target another player's Dude at her location. The Dude must, as his or her controller's next Noon action, call out the Dude of your choice (not controlled by the same player) at this location.

name: Jolinaxas
text: Jolinaxas has a +1 Bullet bonus, a +1 Influence bonus, and a +1 Huckster skill while he has one or more copies of "Faustian Deal" attached.

name: Jordan Caldwell
text: Caldwell ignores all movement restrictions.

name: Juliet "Jewel" Sumner
text: Experienced. Reaction: Immediately before you perform a Noon action, move Jewel to the same location as another one of your Blackjack Dudes.

name: Just What I Need…
text: Shootout: Pay all costs for a non-Gadget Goods in your Play hand and attach it to one of your Dudes in this shootout, regardless of who controls the location. If the Goods is a Weapon, it can be readied immediately.

name: Last Request
text: Reaction: Play after one of your Dudes with a Mystical Goods card attached has been aced. Attach that Mystical Goods card to any one of your Dudes that may legally attach the Goods card, or place it in your discard pile.

name: Life of the Party
text: Noon: Target an unbooted Dude. Move the Dude to a Saloon or Brothel. The ghost rock cost of this card is equal to the Dude's Influence (minimum 1).

name: Lillith
text: Abomination. If this Dude has been aced and is in Boot Hill, you may ace one of your other Dudes as a Noon action to return this Dude to play at your home, unbooted.

name: Lost Angels
text: GR: 19 Your Mystical Goods have their ghost rock cost reduced by 2. Reaction: Boot one of your Dudes immediately before a skill check for a Spell is made. The spell automatically fails.

name: Lt. Colonel Frederick Sykes
text: Noon: Boot Sykes and target an un-Wanted Dude with both Value and Influence less than Sykes. That Dude becomes Wanted. Noon: Boot Sykes and target one of your Wanted Dudes. That Dude becomes un-Wanted.

name: Lucifer's Cane
text: Unique. Mystical. Weapon. Noon: This Dude gains an Influence bonus or a Bullet bonus (you choose) equal to the number of your Blessed in Boot Hill.

name: Lyin' in Wait
text: Reaction: Immediately before the Upkeep Phase, target a Wanted Dude. The Dude has his or her Upkeep cost increased by 2 until after Nightfall.

name: Lynchin' Noose
text: Wanted Dudes in this location have zero Influence.

name: Magic Bus v2.0 (Death Bus)
text: Horse. Gadget Difficulty: 4 Noon: Discard a card from your hand to move this Dude to an adjacent location. This action may be performed any number of times per turn.

name: Mercy
text: Reaction: Play immediately before your opponent begins acing casualties in a shootout. If that player took 2 or more casualties and has at least 2 Dudes in the shootout, that player's casualties are reduced to 0, and you gain 1 Victory Point.

name: Midnight Snack
text: Noon. Harrowed Power: Target one of your unbooted Harrowed Dudes. Until the end of the game, the Dude has the abilities: "Shootout: Target another of your Harrowed Dudes. Move the Dude into this posse, ignoring movement restrictions," and "Noon: Target another of your Harrowed Dude. Move the Dude to this location, ignoring movement restriction." Ace this card.

name: Min Su Tao
text: Noon: Target a Dude that has "Vampire" or "Vampiric" in its Title or as a trait. Move Min Su Tao to the Vampire's location and call out that Dude. The callout may not be refused.

name: Moloch
text: Abomination.

name: Mr. Applegate, Esq.
text: Reaction: Boot Mr. Applegate and pay 6 ghost rock when an action is discarding or acing one of your cards in play to cancel the action.

name: Mr. Slate
text: Experienced. Abomination. Vampire. Mr. Slate may not be called out by non-Terror Dudes.

name: Mysterious Ways
text: Noon Miracle 6: Target one of your Wanted Dudes. If this Miracle succeeds, the Dude becomes un-Wanted.

name: New Pony Express Office
text: Private. Experienced Pony Express. When this Deed enters play, target an out of town Deed. While this Deed is in play, the target Deed is considered to be adjacent and in-town.

name: Night Sentry
text: Owner Shootout: A Sentry joins your posse for the duration of this shootout. The Sentry is a 1 Stud, 0 Influence, ace-Value token Dude. Remove the token Dude from play after the shootout.

name: No Way Out
text: Call outs occurring at this location may not be refused without a card effect.

name: Nyctophobia
text: Noon: Target a Dude in play. The Dude has a -1 Bullet penalty (minimum 0) and a -1 Influence penalty (minimum 0) until after Nightfall while at a Strike.

name: O'Reilly's Five & Dime
text: Public. Controller Noon: Pay 1 ghost rock to target a Goods or Spell in your Boot Hill. Shuffle that card into your deck.

name: Old Scratch
text: Old Scratch may attach (but not use) any Spell card - Your Blessed, Hucksters, and Shamen in the same location as Old Scratch may use Spells attached to Old Scratch as if they were attached to themselves. A Spell may only be used once per turn in this fashion.

name: One Eyed Jacks Are Wild
text: Cheatin'! Reaction: Play when another player reveals an illegal Draw hand. You may change the value and suit of one card in your Draw hand as if it were a Joker. Only one Cheatin'! card can be played against a player per draw.

name: Oswald Hardinger
text: Experienced. Oswald may not move out of town - Oswald does not need to boot to create Gadgets with a Value less than his Mad Scientist skill. Noon: Move Oswald to an in town location.

name: Pandora's Box
text: Unique. Mystical. Weapon. Noon: This Dude gains an Influence bonus or a Bullet bonus (you choose) equal to the number of your Hucksters in Boot Hill.

name: Perdition
text: Abomination. Blessed Dudes in a posse with Perdition have a +1 Bullet bonus and a +1 Blessed skill.

name: Phantoms
text: Shootout: Target a Dude in this shootout. That Dude cannot be targeted with actions until the end of the shootout.

name: Poker Night
text: Put one to four ghost rock into the "pot", matching that amount from the Bank. Any other player may play by matching the amount from their vault. Each participating player draws seven cards to make his or her Draw hand, with the best hand winning the pot. Players revealing an illegal hand cannot win the pot (if all players reveal an illegal hand, the pot goes to the Bank).

name: Power Plant
text: Private. While this Deed is at either end of your Street, its Production is increased by two.

name: Prison Factory
text: Private. Out of Town. Government. The Factory has +1 additional production for each Dude who is out of play in the Jail.

name: Prospectus' Secret Workshop
text: Private. Players other than the owner must discard a card from their Play hand to move a Dude to the Workshop. Controller Noon: Target a Mad Scientist at this location. His or her Mad Scientist skill is increased by +2 until after Nightfall.

name: Rachel Sumner
text: Experienced 2. Noon Job:  Boot Rachel to target an in-town Deed owned by another player worth 1 or more Control Points. If the job succeeds, permanently reduce the Control Points of the Deed by 1, and you gain 1 Victory Point.

name: Raymond Armstrong
text: Experienced. Raymond is a Stud while there is a Texas Ranger controlled by another player in the same location.

name: Recruiter
text: Unique. This Improvement may only be attached to your Home. Any Dudes from your outfit that you bring into play have their ghost rock cost reduced by 1 (minimum 0).

name: Registry
text: Public. Government. Controller Reaction: Boot the Registry immediately before the Upkeep Phase and target a Deed. The owner of that Deed controls it until after Nightfall, regardless of Influence totals.

name: Requiem
text: Noon: Target a Dude in the same location as Requiem. That Dude is considered a Terror until after Nightfall.

name: Rescue Operation
text: Noon Job: Boot one of your Dudes to start a job that targets the Town Square. Any player may defend the job, starting with the Winner and going clockwise. Before posses are formed, go through your deck, remove a Dude and show that card to the other players. If this job succeeds, add the Dude to your Play hand. If the job fails, put the Dude into Boot Hill.

name: Rooster Beenz
text: Reaction: When Beenz is called out, move him to an adjcaent location to refuse the callout even if it may not normally be refused.

name: Run 'em Down!
text: Shootout: All of your Dudes in this Posse with Horses attached either gain a +1 Bullet bonus or become Studs (your choice for each Dude) until then end of the shootout.

name: Rustlers
text: Starting with the Winner and going clockwise, each player may discard one of their Horses in play to gain 5 ghost rock.

name: Sabtabiel's Remains
text: Unique. Mystical. Shootout: Boot this Dude. If this Dude is still in play immediately before Nightfall, you may raise or lower the Fear Level by 1.

name: Salvage Operation
text: Public. Dudes at this location may always attach Goods, regardless of who controls the Salvage Operation. Controller Reaction: Perform this action immediately before you attach a Goods card to one of your Dudes at this Deed. Discard another Goods card attached to that Dude to produce ghost rock equal to half the discarded Good's cost (rounded up)

name: Screamers
text: Bullet. Shootout: Discard the Screamers when another player performs a Shootout action to cancel the action. The action has no effect.

name: Seeking Fury
text: Noon: Discard a card from your Play hand to draw a card from your deck.

name: Sepulcher
text: Unique. During each round of a shootout at this location, immediately before casualties are aced, both players must ace one Dude in their posse.

name: Sewer Tunnels
text: This Improvement may only be attached to an in-town Deed. Wanted Dudes in this location gain a +1 Influence bonus.

name: Sewing Circle
text: Noon: Target a Harrowed Dude in Boot Hill. Return the dude to his or her owner's hand.

name: Shave and a Haircut
text: Noon: Target a Dude in play. The Dude gains a +2 Influence bonus until after Nightfall.

name: Sheriff Syn
text: Reaction: Boot Sheriff Syn to cancel a Shootout Action card played during a shootout she is in.

name: Shigetoshi Hohiro
text: Experienced. Reaction Pull: Boot Shigetoshi when a Spell targets one of your Dudes at this location. If the pull plus Shigetoshi's Blessed rating is greater than the Spell's difficulty, the Spell is canceled without effect.

name: Simon Lambeth
text: Abomination. Simon's Blessed rating is equal to the number of other Blessed in this location.

name: Sin Je
text: Shootout: Target a booted Dude in the opposing posse. Ready Weapons attached to that Dude are made unready. That Dude may not ready a Weapon until after the shootout ends. When the shootout ends, that Dude may ready a Weapon.

name: Sioux: Spirit Warriors
text: GR: 19 Dudes you ace in a shootout are removed from play - no Harrowed pulls are made, and card effects cannot be used to prevent the Dude being aced. No other copies of those Dudes may enter play for the rest of the game.

name: Sister Mercy Winters
text: Shootout: Target a Spell attached to a Dude in the opposing posse. Discard the Spell.

name: Soul Blast Cannon
text: Mystical. Weapon. Gadget Difficulty: 9. This Dude is a Stud. Shootout: Target a Dude in the opposing posse and make a skill check using this Dude's Mad Scientist skill (if any). If the skill check exceeds the target Dude's Value plus Bullet rating, send the Dude home booted. If the skill check exceeds the target's Value plus Bullet Rating by more than 5, ace the Dude instead.

name: Spirit Walk
text: Noon Hex 6: If this Hex succeeds, then until after Nightfall, your next illegal Draw hand may not be targeted by Cheatin'! Cards. Instead, you must ace one of your Dude when you reveal your next illegal Draw hand.

name: Spring Cleaning
text: Controller Noon: Name a Value (A through K). This Deed has that Value until after Nightfall.

name: Stallion
text: Horse. Reaction: Use immediately before you perform a Noon action. Boot the Stallion to move this Dude to any location in play. You may not use this action if this Dude is booted.

name: Strikers' Shaft
text: Non-Unique. Private. Strike. Dudes with 0 Influence have 1 Influence for determining control of this Deed.

name: The Beast Within
text: Noon Spirit 6: If this Spirit succeeds, shuffle your discard pile into your deck and ace this Spirit.

name: The C.S.A. Ourobouros
text: Private. Government. Agency Dudes may not move to this Location. The ghost rock cost to bring this Deed into play is reduced by 2 if you are a Texas Rangers player.

name: The Good Book
text: Unique. Mystical. Reaction: Boot this Dude immediately before the Gambling Phase. Any player that does not ante 2 additional ghost rock may not resolve any events during low ball.

name: The Perch
text: Public. Out of Town. Brothel. Saloon. Controller Noon: Unboot all dudes at this location.

name: This'll Teach You…
text: Noon: All Wanted Dudes in play have a Draw Bullet type until after Nightfall. Ace this card.

name: Three-Card Monte
text: Noon: Use when this Dude is in the Town Square. Gain 1 Ghost Rock. Noon Pull: Boot this Dude while he or she is in the Town Square to target another Dude in the Town Square. If the pull is greater than the target Dude's Value, take 1 ghost rock from his or her controller.

name: Three-Piece Suit
text: This Dude's Value is increased by 3 (maximum K). A Dude may only attach one Three-Piece Suit.

name: Thunderbird
text: Experienced. Noon:  Ace a Spirit attached to Thunderbird to get a card from your discard pile and add it to your Play hand.

name: Trouble There, Buck?
text: Reaction: Play when an action on a Horse card is used. That action is canceled and has no effect. Noon: Discard a Horse card from play.

name: Two Birds Chirping
text: Experienced. Two Birds has a +2 Biullet bonus and a +2 Influence bonus while he has one or more Goods attached that can only be attached to a Sioux.

name: Tzipporah Whateley
text: Experienced. Noon: This action can only be used once per game. Target a Dude in play with a Value less than Tzipprorah's. Until the end of the game, you may perform the following actioin once per turn. Noon: Put a Spell card from your Play hand into Boot Hill to boot the targeted Dude.

name: Under the Gun
text: Reaction: Play immediately before another player makes a pull. The pull is drawn from any deck you choose.

name: War Cry
text: Noon Spirit 4: If this Spirit succeeds, this Dude is a Stud until after Nightfall. Shootout Spirit 8: Target another of your Dudes in this posse. If this Spirit succeeds, both this Shaman and the target Dude are Studs until the end of the shootout.

name: Watering Hole
text: Non-Unique. Public. Saloon. Dudes moving to the Watering Hole are booted.

name: We've Got Hostages
text: Reaction: Play when one of your Dudes is called out. The Dude refuses the call out, moves home booted, and becomes Wanted.

name: Well of Souls
text: Unique. You must boot a Blessed Dude to put this Improvement into play. This Improvement may only be attached to an in-town Deed. Dudes aced at this location are not aced, but are discarded instead. If the Dude is a Blessed, the Dude is sent home booted.

name: William Rose
text: William gains a +2 Bullet bonus while he is Wanted.

name: Working Out The Details
text: Select a Deed. Beginning with the player on your left, each player may move one Dude to that Deed.

name: You're Comin' With Us!
text: Noon Job: Target a skilled Dude in play. Boot one of your Dudes to start a job to recruit that Dude. If the job succeeds, pay the target's controller 2 ghost rock to take control of the Dude until after Nightfall. The Dude moves to your home and unboots (if necessary). If the target is aced during the shootout, the target is not aced (regardless of card effects), and the job is immediately successful. Immediately before Nightfall, if still in play, the Dude returns to his or her owner's control and goes home booted.

name: You've Got This Comin'!
text: Noon Job: Boot one of your Dudes at an out-of-town Deed owned by another player. The Dude starts a job that targets that Deed. If the job succeeds, take an amount of ghost rock from that player equal to the Deed's current production, or the player's total ghost rock if less. All Dudes in your posse become Wanted.

name: Zeke Hillard
text: Zeke is a Stud while he is at a Strike.

name: Big Doc's Casino
text: Controller Reaction: Before hands are drawn during the Gambling Phase, all players must ante 1 additional or one less ghost rock - your choice (players can borrow from the bank but must repay immediately, as when borrowing for ante).

name: Crawford Talmadge
text: Noon Pull: Target a Hex attached to a Huckster at the same location as Crawford. If the pull is greater than the value of the targeted Huckster, the hex card is now attached to Crawford. After nightfall, return the hex to the target (or Boot Hill if the target was aced).

name: Harrowed Kenny
text: Nonunique. Harrowed.  You may not bring Harrowed Kenny into play through normal means. Reaction: When a Kenny you control is aced, remove it from the game. Pay Harrowed Kenny's cost and Pull: If the pull is Black, put Harrowed Kenny into play at your home. This is the only way Kenny can become Harrowed.

name: Hit Me
text: Reaction: Play before the gambling phase begins. You draw and discard an additional card when playing lowball for the gambling phase this turn. Ace this card.

name: Law Dogs: Mob Justice
text: GR: 19 All your Dudes with "Deputy" in the title have their ghost rock cost and upkeep reduced by 1 (minimum 0). Reaction: Boot a Law Dog Dude you control when a wanted Dude moves to an in-town location. Target the wanted Dude and move him or her to another in-town location of your choice.

name: Lilith Vandekamp
text: Experienced. Abomination. Vampire. Noon: Boot any number of your other dudes in Lilith Vandekamp's location. Lilith Vandekamp gains a +1 bullet or +2 value bonus until after Nightfall for each booting Dude.

name: Lucky Rabbit's Foot
text: Reaction: Ace the Lucky Rabbit's Foot after Draw hands have been drawn but before they have been revealed for a shootout this Dude is in.  Discard your Draw hand and draw another hand using all of the same bonuses to the number of cards drawn and discarded.

name: No Mas
text: Reaction: Play immediately after an action card is resolved. Ace the action card and this card.

name: Readin' The Stars
text: Reaction: Play this card when an Event is revealed during the Gambling Phase. The Event is not resolved this turn but is instead resolved next turn as if it had been revealed as part of the player's Gambling Phase draw. This does not affect the actual contents of that player's lowball hand.

name: Start Again
text: Cheatin'! Reaction: Play when another player reveals an illegal Draw hand during a shootout. All the cards in that player's Draw hand are sent to Boot Hill, but are not considered "aced." Those cards may not leave Boot Hill in any way until the end of the game. That player draws five new cards to form his or her new Draw hand. Only one Cheatin'! card can be played against a player per draw.

name: Stop The Presses
text: Noon: Boot a Deed you control with the word "Dispatch" or "Gazette" in the title.  Increase or decrease the Influence of any one Dude by 1 until after Nightfall.

name: Strange Days
text: Pull: If the pull is less than or equal to the current Fear level, all Dudes with a value less than the pull are booted. Ace this card.

name: 1st Baptist Church of Gomorra
text: Public. Holy Ground. Miracles being performed by a Dude at this location have their Difficulty lowered by 2.

name: 2nd Bank of Gomorra
text: Private.

name: A Few Custom Modifications
text: Noon: Target a Gadget attached to one of your Mad Scientists. Discard a Gadget from your hand and choose one action printed on the discarded Gadget. While the targeted Gadget is in play, it has that action printed on it and has its Difficulty increased by 1.

name: Acid Gun
text: Weapon. Gadget Difficulty: 4. Shootout Pull: If the pull is black, this Dude has a -1 Bullet penalty (minimum 0) and is a Draw for this round of the shootout. If the pull is red, this Dude gains a +2 Bullet bonus and is a Stud for this round of the shootout.

name: Aim for the Head
text: Reaction: Play this card when you’ve won a round of a shootout. You can choose the first Dude that your opponent must ace as a result of this round of the shootout.

name: Alfred Barkum, Sr.
text: Alfred Barkum Sr. can move to The Courthouse. Noon: Pay an amount of ghost rock equal to the number of Dudes in this location (including Alfred Barkum Sr.). All other Dudes at this location have their Influence reduced by 1 until after Nightfall

name: Alice Chamberlain
text: Weapon Gadgets created by Alice Chamberlain have their ghost rock cost reduced by 2. Reaction: After you ace a Wanted Dude in a shootout with a posse including Alice, take an additional bounty of 1 ghost rock from the Wanted Dude’s controller (if possible).

name: Arcane Protection
text: Noon Harrowed Power: Target one of your unbooted Harrowed Dudes. Until the end of the game, all Spells targeting that Dude have +5 Difficulty. Ace this card.

name: Armor of Righteousness
text: Shootout Miracle 6: If this Miracle succeeds, target one of your Dudes in this shootout. That Dude cannot be aced in this shootout unless you lose by at least two ranks.

name: Auction
text: Noon: Target a Deed in play. That Deed is Private until after Nightfall. If you are the owner and controller of the Deed, you gain 1 ghost rock for each Dude controlled by another player who is currently at that Deed.

name: Austin Saves Father Juan
text: Each player’s highest-value Dude gains the following ability until after Nightfall: “Shootout: Move this Dude to the location of the current shootout and join either posse, whether invited or not. This Dude cannot join a posse opposing other Dudes in your gang.”

name: Back to Nature
text: Noon Spirit 8: Target a Goods at this location. If this Spirit succeeds, the Goods is aced after Nightfall.

name: Bad to the Bone
text: Noon: Target a Wanted Dude, who gains a +2 Bullet bonus until after Nightfall. Until after Nightfall, Dudes must pay the target’s controller 3 ghost rock to refuse a call-out from the target, in addition to any other costs. Any player other than the target’s controller who aces the target before Nightfall gains 1 Victory Point.

name: Bash
text: Shootout Hex X: The Difficulty of this Hex is equal to the value of a target Goods in the opposing posse. If this Hex succeeds, the Goods is aced.

name: Bat's Breath Mine
text: Private. Strike. All Dudes have their Bullet rating and Influence reduced by 1 (minimum 0) while at the Bat’s Breath Mine.

name: Battle Hymn
text: Noon Miracle X: This Miracle’s Difficulty is equal to three times the number of Blessed at this location. If this Miracle succeeds, all of the Blessed at this location become Studs until after Nightfall.

name: Benediction
text: Shootout Miracle 5: If this Miracle succeeds, all Dudes in this posse gain a +1 Bullet bonus until the end of the shootout.

name: Bind Spirit
text: Noon Spirit X: The Difficulty of this Spirit is equal to the value of a target Terror in this or an adjacent location. If this Spirit succeeds, you gain control of the target until after Nightfall.

name: Bladed Fist
text: Bladed Fist can attach Goods and be targeted as though he were a Sioux Dude. Shootout: Target a Goods with “Knife” in the title in your hand or attached to Bladed Fist. Discard that Goods to give Bladed Fist a +1 Bullet bonus and make him a Stud. This action can be performed any number of times per turn.

name: Blaze of Glory
text: Shootout: Target and ace one of your Dudes in this shootout. None of your other Dudes can be aced during this round of the shootout. Reactions to your Dude being aced cannot be played.

name: Blue Moon
text: Noon: Target and boot a Sioux Dude in play. That Dude’s Influence and Shaman rating are reduced to 0 until after Nightfall.

name: Bogie Man
text: Abomination. Non-Unique. The Bogie Man will not attach Goods. The Bogie Man’s Influence is equal to the current Fear level, but his Influence is not added to your total during Nightfall. You cannot move any of your non-Terror Dudes into a location with the Bogie Man.

name: Bone Fiend
text: Abomination. Non-Unique. The Bone Fiend will not attach Goods. There is no limit to the number of Bone Fiends each player can have in play. Card memory does not apply to Bone Fiends. The ghost rock cost of the Bone Fiend is reduced by 1 for each Huckster you have in play. The Bone Fiend cannot be aced during a shootout unless your hand is beaten by at least two ranks.

name: Bookstore
text: Private. Controller Noon: Pay 3 ghost rock and discard a card from your Play hand. Get any one Spell from your deck, show it to the other players, and put it in your Play hand. Shuffle the deck.

name: Bottleneck Mine
text: Private. Strike.

name: Bull Whip
text: Noon: Boot this Dude to boot another Dude at this location.

name: Burnt Offerin'
text: Noon Miracle Job 6: Boot this Blessed to start a job that targets a Deed. If the job succeeds and this Blessed is still in the posse, make the Spell pull. If the Miracle succeeds, the Deed and this Miracle are aced and you gain 1 Victory Point.

name: Caught in the Crossfire
text: Shootout: Target one of your Dudes in your posse. The Dude gains a +1 Bullet bonus until the end of the shootout for every Dude by which your posse outnumbers the opposing posse.

name: Choking Gas
text: Gadget Difficulty: 4. Noon Pull: Ace the Choking Gas. All Dudes at this location with a value less than the pull must boot and go home.

name: Claws
text: Noon Harrowed Power: Target one of your unbooted Harrowed Dudes. Until the end of the game, the target has a +2 Bullet bonus while he or she has no ready Weapons. Ace this card.

name: Clear Out!
text: Noon Miracle X: You can choose any Difficulty for this Miracle. If this Miracle succeeds, all Dudes at this location (including this Blessed) with a value less than the Difficulty go home booted. Dudes with a value less than the Difficulty cannot move to this location until after Nightfall.

name: Clell Miller
text: Experienced. Clell Miller gains a permanent +1 Bullet bonus every time a posse he is in aces a Law Dogs or Blackjacks Dude.

name: Cloak
text: Noon Miracle 8: If this Miracle succeeds, this Blessed cannot be targeted by other players’ actions until after Nightfall.

name: Clumsiness
text: Noon Spirit 5: If this Spirit succeeds, any one Dude in this location has a -2 Bullet penalty (minimum 0) until after Nightfall. Shootout Spirit 7: If this Spirit succeeds, any one Dude in the opposing posse has a -2 Bullet penalty (minimum 0) until after Nightfall.

name: Coleman Returns
text: Until after Nightfall next turn, a second (different) Cheatin’! card can be played on a player per draw.

name: Collegium: The New Front
text: GR: 18 All of your Collegium Dudes gain a +1 Influence bonus while they have at least 1 Gadget Weapon attached and ready. You gain 1 Victory Point every time you ace an opposing Stud in a shootout if one of your Dudes in the posse has a Gadget Weapon ready.

name: Culling of the Blessed
text: The Blessed Dude (or Dudes) in play with the lowest skill rating is aced. Ace this card.

name: Dark Beast
text: Abomination. Non-Unique. The Dark Beast will not attach Goods. When the Dark Beast is at a Strike, it gains a Bullet bonus equal to half the current Fear level rounded down.

name: Dark Protection
text: Reaction Hex X: Boot this Huckster when Draw hands are compared in a shootout he or she is in. The Difficulty of this Hex is equal to the opponent’s hand rank. If this Hex succeeds, none of your Dudes has to be aced as a result of this round of the shootout.

name: Darren Titus
text: Noon: Use when Darren and another Blackjacks Dude are in the Town Square. Target and boot the other Dude to give Darren a +1 Influence bonus until after Nightfall. You can do this any number of times per turn. Darren loses this Influence bonus while at home.

name: Deer Eater
text: Other players’ Shootout actions cannot target Deer Eater. Deer Eater will not trade away Goods. Noon: If Deer Eater is not equipped with a Sioux-only Goods card, attach one to him from your Play hand for 2 less ghost rock.

name: Deputy Dave Montreal
text: Call-outs from Deputy Dave Montreal cannot be refused unless he is Wanted.

name: Deputy Milo Powell
text: Deputy Milo Powell is a Stud whenever you are the Winner.

name: Dervish
text: Shootout Miracle 5: If this Miracle succeeds, this Blessed gains a +1 Bullet bonus until the end of the shootout if he or she does not have a ready Weapon. Shootout Miracle 8: If this Miracle succeeds, this Blessed gains a +3 Bullet bonus until the end of the shootout if he or she does not have a ready Weapon.

name: Desmond Quentin
text: Desmond Quentin will not trade a Gadget to a non-Agency Dude.

name: Devil's Plaything
text: Noon Miracle 6: If this Miracle succeeds, ace a Gadget in this location.

name: Devil's Touch
text: Noon. Harrowed Power: Target an unbooted Harrowed Dude you control. Ace this card. Until the end of the game, the target has the ability “Noon: Ace a Goods at this location.”

name: Double-barreled Shotgun
text: Weapon. Shootout: Ace any one opposing Dude whose value is equal to or lower than this Dude’s Bullet rating.

name: Dream Catcher
text: Terrors cannot call out this Dude. Terrors in the same location as this Dude have a -1 Bullet penalty (minimum 0) and a -1 Influence penalty (minimum 0).

name: Ectoplasmic Calcifier
text: Weapon. Gadget Difficulty: 6. While one or more Terrors are in the opposing posse during a shootout, this Dude is a Stud and gains a Bullet bonus equal to his or her Mad Scientist rating.

name: Electrostatic Pump Gun
text: Weapon. Gadget Difficulty: 5. Shootout: This Dude gains a +1 Bullet bonus until the end of the shootout. Shootout: This Dude gains a +1 Bullet bonus until the end of the shootout.

name: Elysium Fields Mine
text: Private. Strike.

name: Extra Room
text: Private. Non-Unique. Improvement. Attach the Extra Room to a Deed you own when the Extra Room enters play. While the Extra Room is attached, that Deed has its final Production increased by 1 (if it has Production greater than 0). If the Deed is descarded or aced, so is the Extra Room. There can be any number or Extra Rooms in play. Card memory does not apply to the Extra Room.

name: Fall Guy
text: Noon: Target one of your Wanted Dudes and one of your non-Wanted Dudes. The Wanted Dude becomes un-Wanted, and the non-Wanted Dude becomes Wanted. Noon: Target one of you non-Wanted Dudes. That Dude becomes Wanted, and all current penalties to your Control Point total are reduced to 0.

name: False Face
text: Noon Spirit 5: If this Spirit succeeds, this Shaman can switch locations with any one of your Dudes in play. Movement restrictions apply. Noon Spirit 9: If this Spirit succeeds, this Shaman can switch locations with any one Dude in play. Movement restrictions apply.

name: Ferret's Eye
text: Noon: Boot Ferret’s Eye to move him to an adjacent location that contains a Huckster controlled by another player. Ferret’s Eye calls out that Huckster.

name: Ferryman's Fee
text: Noon. Harrowed Power: Target an unbooted Harrowed Dude you control. Ace this card. Until the end of the game, the target has the ability “Noon: Move this Dude to an out-of-town location.”

name: Field Test
text: Reaction: Play this card after a Mad Scientist boots to create a Gadget. Unboot the Mad Scientist. The Mad Scientist cannot create any more Gadgets this turn.

name: Fight Like a Man
text: Shootout: All Weapons on Dudes in this shootout become unready. Dudes cannot make Weapons ready during this shootout. Any Dude who is leaving this shootout, and all Dudes at the end of the shootout, can make one Weapon ready.

name: Findley's Quill Pen
text: Unique. This card has no ghost rock cost when being attached to Howard Findley. While this Dude and the Deed he or she is in are controlled by the same player, the Deed has its printed Production increased by 2.

name: Flim
text: Abomination. Experienced. Flim cannot attach Goods. Flim has no Upkeep cost when he is adjacent to Elijah. Shootout: Flim gains a +1 Bullet bonus until the end of the shootout. Flim can perform this action once per shootout round.

name: Fortune-Teller's Shop
text: Private. Controller Noon: Look at the top card of any deck.

name: Fountain
text: Non-Unique. Public. Deeds adjacent to the Fountain are each worth 1 extra Control Point.

name: Freddy Fast Hands
text: Freddy Fast-Hands will not attach Weapons. Shootout: Freddy Fast-Hands becomes a Stud for this round of the shootout. Shootout: Boot Freddy Fast-Hands to target a Weapon in the opposing posse. That Weapon becomes unready and cannot be made ready until after Nightfall.

name: Ghost Infestation
text: If a Ghost Infestation is in play, that card and this card are aced. Otherwise, attach this card to your home. While this card is in play, no player can win unless he or she also has more Control Points plus Victory Points than the current Fear level.

name: Ghost Train
text: All Terrors have their ghost rock and Upkeep costs reduced by 2 until after Nightfall.

name: Glom
text: Non-Unique. Abomination. The ‘Glom cannot attach Goods. Reaction: When another Dude in the same location as the ‘Glom is aced and goes to Boot Hill, the ‘Glom gains a permanent +1 Bullet bonus.

name: Groom
text: Noon Hex 6: If this Hex succeeds, this Huckster gains a +1 Influence bonus until after Nightfall.

name: Guard Dog House
text: Private. Improvement. Attach the Guard Dog House to a Deed you own when the Guard Dog House enters play. While the Guard Dog House is attached, Dudes with a Bullet rating less than 2 cannot move to that Deed. If the Deed is discarded or aced, so is the Guard Dog House.

name: Hiding in the Bushes
text: Shootout: Boot and move one of your unbooted Dudes at home to this location. He or she joins your posse.

name: High Noon
text: Noon Pull: The Dude in play whose value is closest to the pull (determine randomly if there is a tie) moves to the Town Square.
