That Dude can call out any Dude in play controlled by another player (regardless of location). The call-out can be refused as usual. If the call-out is accepted, the other Dude moves to the Town Square for the shootout. Movement costs and restrictions are ignored. The winner of the shootout gains 1 Victory Point.

name: Holme's Workshop
text: Private. All Gadget Weapons made by a Mad Scientist at this location have their ghost rock cost and Difficulty reduced by 2 until after Nightfall. Each Mad Scientist can attempt to create one Gadget per turn without booting while at Holmes’ Workshop (additional Gadgets require booting as usual).

name: Horse Thief
text: Noon: Boot one of your Dudes. Target a Horse in play. Your Dude becomes Wanted, the Horse goes to its owner’s discard pile, and you gain an amount of ghost rock equal to the Horse’s cost.

name: Hostile Takeover
text: Noon: Target a non-Strike Deed you control. Boot one of your Dudes at the Deed to become the owner of the Deed until it leaves play. If the Deed leaves play, ownership immediately returns to its original owner.

name: Howard Findley
text: Experienced. While Howard Findley is in play, your Strikes cost 1 less ghost rock to put into play. Findley is a Stud while in a shootout at home.

name: Hunter's Moon Strike
text: Private. Strike.

name: Interpret Vision
text: Noon Miracle 6: If this Miracle succeeds, this Blessed gains a +1 Influence bonus until after Nightfall.

name: Invisibility
text: Noon Spirit 8: If this Spirit succeeds, this Shaman cannot be targeted by other players’ actions until after Nightfall.

name: Jacob the Healer
text: Reaction: When a Dude is aced, boot Jacob the Healer to move the Dude home instead of acing the Dude. The Dude is aced immediately after Nightfall.

name: Jeb Parker
text: If Jeb Parker is controlled by a player who is not a Blackjacks player, his Upkeep cost is 4.

name: John the Doomsayer
text: Reaction: When you are discarding a card from your Play hand without using an effect on the card, you can boot John the Doomsayer instead. Place the card face-down under him. The card cannot affect or be affected by cards in play. If John the Doomsayer is aced or discarded, so is the card. Noon: Discard the cards in your Play hand, replacing them with the cards under John the Doomsayer. Discard John the Doomsayer.

name: Julius Bailey
text: When Julius Bailey succeeds in creating a Gadget with a red pull, the Gadget is aced immediately after Nightfall if in play.

name: Katie Karl
text: Experienced. All Dudes in a posse with Katie Karl are Studs while she remains in the shootout. While Katie Karl is in your posse, card effects cannot prevent you from playing Shootout actions.

name: Kentucky Windage
text: Shootout Hex 5: If this Hex succeeds, target a Dude in the opposing posse. Until the end of this shootout, card effects cannot prevent the target Dude from being aced. Any card effect that would prevent the target Dude from being aced is negated.

name: Law Dogs: Hunter's Office
text: GR: 18 All Weapons you put into play have their ghost rock cost halved, rounded down. Noon: Select one of your Dudes and target a Wanted Dude at the same location. Your Dude calls out the Wanted Dude. You can use this action any number of times per turn.

name: Lucifer Whateley
text: Abomination. Lucifer’s Bullet rating, Influence, and Upkeep cost are equal to half the Fear level, rounded up.

name: Manitou's Control
text: Noon Pull: Target a Harrowed Dude. If the pull is greater than the Dude’s value, control of the Dude passes to the player to the left of the current controller. Control of the Dude returns to normal after Nightfall. Ace this card.

name: Marcus Perriwinkle
text: Experienced. Reaction: When Marcus Perriwinkle is aced, you can ace a Gadget in your hand with a higher value than Marcus Perriwinkle’s instead. Marcus Perriwinkle returns to your home booted.

name: Martyr's Mirror
text: Shootout Hex 8: If this Hex succeeds, this Huckster’s Bullet rating is increased to equal the Bullet rating of one Dude in the opposing posse.

name: Mary the Wanderer
text: Noon: Move Mary the Wanderer to an adjacent location. This does not boot her.

name: McCracken Brothers
text: If the McCracken Brothers are aced in a shootout, it is considered acing two of your Dudes in the shootout.

name: Meredith Kills the Hooded Figure
text: Lower the Fear level by 1. Ace the Unknown Hooded Figure. This Event does not resolve if another copy of it has already resolved this game. Ace this card whether it resolves or not.

name: Mirror, Mirror
text: Noon. Harrowed Power: Target an unbooted Harrowed Dude you control. Ace this card. Until the end of the game, the target has the ability “Noon: Choose one action printed on a Dude at this location. Until after Nightfall, this Harrowed Dude can perform that action as if it were printed on this Harrowed Dude.”

name: Miss Greene's Room
text: Public. Brothel. Casino. Dudes with less than 1 Influence cannot move to Miss Greene’s Room.

name: Montana Holland
text: If Montana Holland has a ready Weapon with the word “Rifle” in the title, she can join a posse from an adjacent location without booting and/or while booted.

name: Mr. Bones
text: Non-Unique. Grifter. Noon: Show your Play hand to all of your opponents.  If it does not contain any Cheatin’! cards, boot Mr. Bones to get any one Cheatin’! card from your discard pile. Show the card to your opponents, then add it to your Play hand. Discard a card from your Play hand.

name: Mr. Prim
text: Mr. Prim’s Influence is 0 while he is out of town.

name: New Moon Saloon
text: Public. Saloon. The New Moon Saloon counts as the Old Moon Saloon for uniqueness. Reduce the New Moon Saloon’s ghost rock cost by 1 for each Mad Scientist in play.

name: New Town Hall
text: Public. Whenever the current controller loses control of the New Town Hall or the New Town Hall leaves play, the controller loses all Town Hall Victory Points. This Deed's controller is always the player with the most Influence at it (owner wins ties), regardless of other card effects.  Controller Noon: Gain 1 Town Hall Victory Point

name: Night Haunt Attack
text: Noon: Target a booted Dude, who is called out by a Night Haunt and cannot refuse. No other Dudes can join this shootout. The Night Haunt is an ace-value, 0-Bullet, 0-Influence Dude. The Night Haunt does not draw during the shootout-instead, the Night Haunt’s Draw hand rank is equal to the current Fear level minus 2. The Night Haunt leaves play after the shootout ends. Ace this card.

name: Nightmare
text: Noon. Harrowed Power: Target an unbooted Harrowed Dude you control. Ace this card. Until the end of the game, this Harrowed Dude has the ability “Noon: Target another Dude at this location. The target’s Influence is reduced by 2 until after Nightfall.”

name: No End in Sight
text: Reaction: Play this card immediately after a player plays a Cheatin’! card. Any number of additional Cheatin’! cards can be played against that player this draw. Ace this card.

name: Only Winged 'Em
text: Reaction: Play when a Dude is aced. The Dude is not aced, but is discarded instead.

name: Pact with Darkness
text: Reaction Hex X: Cast this Hex at the beginning of the Upkeep Phase. X is the value of a target Abomination. If this Hex succeeds, the Abomination’s Upkeep cost is reduced to 0 for this turn. Noon Hex X: X is twice the value of a target Abomination. If this Hex succeeds, the Abomination’s Upkeep cost is 0 while this Huckster is in play.

name: Peevie
text: Reduce Peevie’s Upkeep cost by 1 for each Mad Scientist in your gang

name: Phillip Goodson
text: Abomination. Reaction: When hands have been revealed in a shootout Phillip Goodson is in, and his posse’s hand contains exactly three different, natural 7’s, the rank of that hand is increased by three ranks and is considered the worst possible hand of that rank.

name: Pickpocket
text: Noon Pull: Target one of your Dudes and a Goods in the same location that can be legally attached to the Dude. If the pull is greater than the value of the Goods, the Goods is attached to the Dude. Otherwise, the Dude becomes Wanted.

name: Pit Wasp Swarm
text: Abomination. The Pit Wasp Swarm cannot attach Goods. A Dude cannot move into the Pit Wasp Swarm’s location unless the Dude has a higher value than the Pit Wasp Swarm. The Pit Wasp Swarm can only move to an adjacent location, a Strike, or the Town Square.

name: Po Yu
text: Experienced. Noon: Use when Po Yu is at a Strike you own and control. Target and ace another player's Abomination at this location.

name: Rachel Murders Warwick
text: All Dudes have their printed Influence replaced by their printed Bullet rating. This lasts until after Nightfall. Ace Judge Henry Warwick. Rachel Sumner becomes Wanted. Ace this card.

name: Razor-Cliff Mine
text: Private. Non-Unique. Strike.

name: Red-Handed
text: Cheatin’! Reaction: Play this card when another player reveals an illegal Draw hand. All of that player’s Dudes become Wanted. Only one Cheatin’! card can be played against a player per draw.

name: Riot
text: All Dudes with 0 Influence are turned face-down until after Nightfall. While face-down, those Dudes are considered out of play except for uniqueness purposes. Ace this card.

name: Ritual Scars
text: Noon: Target one of your Dudes with a skill rating and Influence greater than 0. That Dude’s Influence is permanently decreased by 1, and his or her skill rating is permanently increased by 1. No Dude can be targeted by Ritual Scars more than once per game. Ace this card.

name: Robert Holmes
text: Experienced. Reaction: Boot Robert Holmes as one of your Goods is coming into play. You can immediately attach that Goods to another of your unbooted Dudes, regardless of that Dude’s location and whether or not you control that location.

name: Rocket Boots
text: Gadget Difficulty: 4. Noon: If this Dude is at a Strike, boot the Rocket Boots to move this Dude to another Strike. Ace any non-Gadget Horse attached to this Dude.

name: Run-Down Lot
text: Public. When the Run-Down Lot enters play, you can put it on one of your opponents’ streets, under your control. The Deeds adjacent to the Run-Down Lot have a -1 Production penalty. A player with the Run-Down Lot on his or her street can boot a Dude at the Run-Down Lot as a Noon action to discard the Run-Down Lot.

name: Sally Daniels
text: Noon Pull: Boot Sally Daniels. Target a Goods at this location that can legally be attached to her. If the pull is greater than the value of the Dude with the Goods, the Goods is attached to Sally. Sally can do this even if you do not control the location.

name: Sauce for the Gander
text: Cheatin'! Reaction: Play this card when another player reveals an illegal Draw hand. If you have a Draw hand, exchange Draw hands with that player. Cheatin’! cards cannot be played on you this draw. The cards are discarded into their owners’ discard piles normally after the draw is completed. Only one Cheatin’! card can be played against a player per draw.

name: Sawed-off Shotgun
text: Weapon. This Dude is a Stud while the Sawed-Off Shotgun is ready. The Sawed-Off Shotgun decreases the Dude’s Bullet rating by 1 (minimum 0).

name: Secret Bomb
text: Noon Pull: Ace a Deed you own. Target one Dude on that Deed before he or she goes home. If the pull is greater than or equal to the Dude’s value, the Dude is aced.

name: Secret Identity
text: Noon: One of your Wanted Dudes becomes un-Wanted.

name: Secret Lab
text: Private. You must boot one of your Mad Scientists to bring the Secret Lab into play. Non-Mad-Scientist Dudes cannot move to the Secret Lab except by card effect. All Mad Scientists have a +1 Mad Scientist bonus while at the Secret Lab.

name: Shootin' from the Hip
text: Reaction: Play this card immediately before Draw hands are compared in a shootout if you have an unbooted Stud in the shootout. Boot your Stud. If able, your opponent must immediately ace a Dude in his or he posse with a Bullet rating less than your Stud’s Bullet rating.

name: Shouting Tom
text: Shouting Tom is worth 1 Control Point for his controller while he is in the Town Square.

name: Singing Feather
text: Experienced. Harrowed Dudes in the same location as Singing Feather cannot perform Noon or Shootout actions on their cards.

name: Sister Mary Jebediah
text: Experienced. All Terrors in a shootout opposing Sister Mary have the ability “Shootout: Boot this Dude to go home.” Shootout: Target a Terror in the opposing posse whose value is lower than 10 minus the current Fear level. Ace the Terror.

name: Skunky Swade
text: Skunky Swade will not move to a location you do not own. His Influence does not add to your total during Nightfall. Noon: Send a Dude home booted from this location if this location is a Strike you own. Shootout: Target an opposing Dude in this shootout. If the shootout is at a Strike you own, the target is sent home booted.

name: Sleeping with Shadows
text: If any Terrors are in play, the player (or players) with the most Terrors in play has his or her lowest value Dude (or Dudes) aced, and you must ace this card. If no Terrors are in play, this card is discarded without effect.

name: Slumber Needle
text: Gadget Difficulty: 4. Noon: Ace the Slumber Needle. Boot a Dude at this location.

name: Spike Dougan
text: Experienced. Harrowed.

name: Sticks to Snakes
text: Shootout Spirit X: Target a Dude in the opposing posse. X is the value of the Dude. If this Spirit succeeds, send the Dude home booted.

name: Stitchin'
text: Noon Harrowed Power: Target one of your unbooted Harrowed Dudes. Until the end of the game, the Dude has the ability “Reaction: When a Harrowed pull is sending this Dude home from a shootout, this Dude is sent home without booting.” Ace this card.

name: Stone Man
text: Abomination. The Stone Man will not attach Goods.

name: Strikes a Hawk
text: Strikes a Hawk is a Stud when she has a Bow and Arrow ready.

name: Sumner's Revenge
text: If one of your Dudes was aced by another player during a shootout last turn, any one of your Dudes can immediately move to the Town Square and call out any target Dude controlled by the player who aced your Dude. The target Dude must move to the Town Square and accept the shootout. Movement restrictions are ignored.

name: Sweetrock Smoking Lounge
text: Private. Non-Sweetrock Dudes have their Influence reduced by 1 (minimum 0) while in the Sweetrock Smoking Lounge.

name: Sweetrock: Western Corporate Office
text: GR: 24 After revealing your starting posse, you can pay for and put into play one non-Control Point Strike. Other players' Dudes can only move to that Strike using a card effect. All of your Dudes gain a +1 Bullet bonus while at a Strike you own.

name: Sympathy for the Devil
text: Noon Hex X: Target an opponent’s Dude at this location. This Huckster calls out the Dude, who cannot refuse. No other Dudes can join. If the Dude is aced in the shootout, make the Hex pull. X is the value plus twice the Influence of the Dude. If successful, gain Victory Points equal to the Dude’s Influence and remove the Dude from play - no other copy can enter play this game. Ace this Hex.

name: Tack and Harness Shop
text: Private. Controller Reaction: Gain 1 ghost rock when a Horse comes into play.

name: Takin' Cover
text: Shootout: Target one of your Dudes in this shootout. That Dude cannot be targeted by other players’ actions until the shootout is over. Until the end of the shootout, the target Dude cannot be aced unless your hand is beaten by at least one rank.

name: Tao Cheng (“T.C.”)
text: Experienced. Noon: T.C. can call out any one Maze Rat in this or an adjacent location. Shootout: T.C. gains a +2 Bullet bonus until the end of the shootout if none

name: Tapped Out
text: Pull: Any Strikes with a value equal to the pull are either discarded or aced (owner’s choice). The owners of aced Strikes gain an amount of ghost rock equal to twice the printed Production of each of their aced Strikes.

name: Telescopic Pistol Sight
text: Gadget Difficulty: 5. Shootout: Boot the Telescopic Pistol Sight. When your next Draw hand is revealed, the suit of all of the cards in the hand is changed to Clubs. This makes your next Draw hand an illegal hand regardless or the cards therein.

name: Terrormental
text: Abomination. The Terrormental will not attach Goods. The Terrormental cannot be targeted with Spell actions.

name: The Back Room
text: Private. Non-Unique. When The Back Room enters play, place it behind an in-town Deed you own. The Back Room is adjacent only to the Deed to which it is attached unless adjacency is granted by a card effect. Dudes can only move into The Back Room from an adjacent location.

name: The Cooper
text: Public.

name: The Labyrinth Mine
text: Private. Strike.

name: The Lode
text: Public. Strike. In Town. When The Lode enters play, put a token on it. Before each High Noon, add a token. The Lode’s Control Points and Production are equal to its number of tokens. The Lode’s controller collects its Production even if not the owner. This Deed's controller is always the player with the most Influence at it (owner wins ties), regardless of other card effects.

name: The Mother Lode is Found
text: Raise the Fear level by 2. The Sweetrock Dude (or Dudes) in play with the highest Influence goes insane and is discarded. This Event does not resolve if another copy of it has already resolved this game. Ace this card whether it resolves or not.

name: The Side Pocket Billiard Hall
text: Public. Saloon. Billiard Hall. Controller Noon: Pay an amount of ghost rock equal to The Side Pocket Billiard Hall’s cost. You are now considered the owner of The Side Pocket Billiard Hall until the end of the game.

name: The Spirits Flee
text: Reaction Spirit 10: When another player plays an Action card, boot this Shaman. Pull from that player’s deck for this Spirit. If this Spirit succeeds, the Action is canceled without effect.

name: The Steam Tunnel Lode
text: Private. Strike.

name: The T and Q Cattle Ranch
text: Private. Out of Town.

name: Theatre
text: Public. All Hucksters the controller is bringing into play have their ghost rock cost decreased by 2.

name: This Round is on Us
text: Noon: Target one of your Dudes. Until after Nightfall, that Dude is considered to have 1 greater Influence for the purposes of controlling the Deed he or she was in when you played this card. This does not affect your total combined Influence.

name: Throw Your Weight Around
text: Noon: Target one of your Dudes. Until after Nightfall, that Dude’s Influence is always equal to his or her Bullet rating. That Dude cannot refuse a call-out until after Nightfall.

name: Time Vision Goggles
text: Gadget Difficulty: 6. Reaction Pull: Boot the Time Vision Goggles when another player reveals an Event. If the pull is red, the Event resolves as if you had put it into play instead.

name: Today, I Am
text: Reaction: Play this card when another player plays an action that is moving your Dude out of the shootout. Your Dude remains in the shootout and gains a +2 Bullet bonus until the end of the shootout. Boot your Dude if he or she is unbooted.

name: Trick Shootin'
text: Shootout Pull: Target one of your Dudes in this shootout. If the pull is red, your Dude gains a +2 Bullet bonus and becomes a Stud until the end of the shootout. If the pull is black, your Dude has a -2 Bullet penalty (minimum 0) until the end of the shootout.

name: Two Hands, Two Guns
text: Shootout: Target one of your Dudes in this shootout. That Dude can have two Weapons ready for the duration of this shootout. Choose one unready Weapon, which becomes ready if it can legally be made ready. At the end of the shootout, choose one ready Weapon to keep ready; the other Weapon becomes unready.

name: Undead Miners
text: Ace one of your Strikes. Target another one of your Strikes. The target Strike has it’s printed Production permanently doubled. Ace this card

name: Unknown Hooded Figure
text: Experienced. Harrowed. You must have another Whateley Dude in play to bring the Unknown Hooded Figure into play. Other Whateley Dudes in the Unknown Hooded Figure’s location cannot be called out while the Unknown Hooded Figure is unbooted

name: Unnatural Selection
text: Noon. Harrowed Power: Target an unbooted Harrowed Dude you control. Ace this card. Until the end of the game, this Dude has the ability “Reaction: Immediately after a Dude in this Dude’s location fails a skill pull, the skilled Dude can pull again. If the second pull is successful, the first pull is ignored and the skill pull is successful.”

name: Vision Quest
text: Noon Spirit 5: Boot this Shaman. If this Spirit succeeds, you can discard any or all of the cards in your Play hand.

name: Walter Ponds
text: When Walter enters play, target a Dude with Influence less than Walter’s. Walter enters play at the location of the targeted Dude. The Dude is sent home and is unbooted.

name: Warwick's Gavel
text: Unique. Warwick’s Gavel has no ghost rock cost when being attached to Henry Warwick. Noon: Target a Wanted Dude. That Dude becomes un-Wanted. Noon: Target a Dude under the effects of the Jail. That Dude is returned to play and sent home booted.

name: Water to Wine
text: Noon Miracle 7: If this Miracle succeeds, all Dudes at this location are booted. If this location is a Saloon or Brothel, its Production is raised by 2 for the next Upkeep Phase.

name: Wave Shadow
text: Abomination. Non-Unique. The Wave Shadow cannot attach Goods. There is no limit to the number of Wave Shadows that each player can have in play. Wave Shadows cannot be targeted by other players’ Action cards. Card memory does not apply to Wave Shadows.

name: Weapons Tax
text: For each Weapon in play (ready or unready), its owner must pay 1 ghost rock or discard it.

name: Whiskey Nick's Joint
text: Private. Saloon. Controller Noon: One of your Dudes (your choice) at Whiskey Nick’s Joint gains a +1 Bullet bonus and is a Stud until after Nightfall.

name: William Badson
text: Abomination. Reaction: When hands have been revealed in a shootout William Badson is in, and his posse’s hand contains exactly three different, natural 6s, the rank of that hand is increased by three ranks and is considered the worst possible hand of that rank.

name: Xiong "Wendy" Cheng
text: Experienced. Reaction: When a Dude refuses a call-out from Xiong “Wendy” Cheng, the Dude permanently has a -1 Influence and -1 Bullet penalty (minimum 0).

name: You're Not Fast Enough...
text: Reaction: Play this card after one of your Dudes accepts a call-out from a Dude with a lower Bullet rating. No other Dudes can join the shootout. No Reactions other than Cheatin’! cards can be played during this shootout.

name: You're With Me
text: Reaction: Play this card when one of your Dudes has moved to a new location. Target and move one of your unbooted Dudes to the same location. Costs to move, such as booting, must be paid as usual.

name: Any One of Ya!
text: Noon: Choose one of your unbooted dudes in town, and move him or her into Town Square, booted. Target another Player who may call your dude out with any dude (even booted dudes and those that normally may not call your dude out) in town he controls, moving him or her to the Town Square. If the player does not, you gain one Victory Point. No other dudes may join this Shootout.

name: Babble On
text: Noon Miracle X: Boot this blessed and target one dude in play. The difficulty of this Miracle is three times the target's Influence. If this Miracle is successful, the target has his or her Influence reduced to zero until after Nightfall.

name: Barthalomew Prospectus
text: Reaction: Boot Bartholomew immediately after you perform a noon action. You may perform another one immediately.

name: Black Jack
text: Experienced. Black Jack is always Wanted and cannot become un-Wanted. You always perform the first Shootout action instead of the Winner when Black Jack is in your posse, continuing to the player on your left.

name: Blueprints
text: Noon: Take one deed from your Boot Hill and put it in your hand.

name: Bolts o' Doom
text: Shootout Hex 5: Raise this Huckster's Bullet rating by two until the end of the Shootout.

name: Bowie Knife
text: A Dude cannot gain a Bullet bonus from more than one Bowie Knife at a time.

name: Buffalo Chip Saloon
text: To call a dude out in the Buffalo Chip Saloon, a player must pay one GR to the Buffalo Chip's controller.

name: Camille Sinclair
text: Shootout: Use when there is a Terror in the opposing posse. Camille gains a +1 Bullet bonus until the end of the shootout.

name: Coleman's Badge
text: While the Badge is attached, this dude's value is increased by three (no maximum) and has +1 Influence. Noon: This dude becomes un-Wanted.

name: Confession
text: Noon Miracle X: Target one non-Abomination dude in play. The difficulty of this Miracle is the dude's value. If this Miracle is successful, the dude becomes wanted. This Miracle cannot target a Whateley.

name: Dealer's Choice
text: All Draws are played as lowball until after Nightfall. Ace this card.

name: Dumb Luck
text: Reaction: Play immediately after a successful Spell pull. Cancel the pull and target the Dude casting the Spell, who must pull again. If the second pull fails, the Dude is booted and cannot take any other actions this turn.

name: Elijah
text: Abominations cannot call out Elijah.

name: Eureka?!?
text: If "Eureka!" is in play, send it to its owner's Boot Hill. Attach Eureka?!? to the home of the player to your left. When Eureka?!? attaches to a player's home, the player discards one card from his or her Play hand. A player's maximum hand size is reduced by one while Eureka?!? is attached. If the player wins a shootout, Eureka?!? leaves and attaches to the next player on the left.  Only one Eureka can be in play at a time - discard any subsequent copies.

name: Exorcism
text: Noon Miracle X: The difficulty of this Miracle is the value of a Terror in the same or an adjacent location. If this Miracle is successful, the Terror is aced. If this Miracle is successful by more than 5 points, the Terror is aced, sent to Boot Hill automatically, and can never return to play.

name: Flam
text: Abomination. No Goods. Shootout: Join a posse that contains Elijah. You may send Elijah home, booted.

name: Flim
text: Abomination. No Goods. Flim has no upkeep when he is adjacent to Elijah. Shootout: Ace any one dude in the opposing posse with a value lower than Flim's bullet rating.

name: Gluttony
text: All Goods being attached to Gluttony have their costs reduced by two. Goods cannot be moved off of Gluttony without a card effect.

name: I Got the Pistols…
text: Reaction: Play immediately after a job is determined to be successful and you have a Dude in the Dealer's posse. Your dude is now considered the Dealer for this job as if you were performing the action.

name: Inspiration
text: Reaction Miracle X: Immediately after one of your Dudes aces a Terror with a value greater than 5, perform this Miracle. X is twice the current Fear Level. If this Miracle succeeds, you gain one Victory Point. Discard this Miracle.

name: J.P. Coleman
text: Experienced. Harrowed. The Former Sheriff. Reaction: When J.P. is aced in a shootout, target one Dude in the opposing posse. Until the end of the game, J.P. gains a +1 Bullet bonus (cumulative) while opposing that Dude in a shootout.

name: Jack's Left Shooter
text: Unique. Weapon. The Left Shooter can be attached to Black Jack without cost.  Noon: Call out a dude at this location, even if your dude is booted. Your dude cannot use any other weapons for this Shootout except Jack's Right Shooter.

name: Jack's Right Shooter
text: Unique. Weapon. The Right Shooter can be attached to Black Jack without cost. Shootout Pull: If the pull is less than your dude's bullet rating (including Jack's Left and Right Shooters), ace one opposing dude. Your dude cannot use any other weapons for this Shootout except Jack's Left Shooter.

name: Jackelope Stampede
text: Cheatin'! Reaction: Play when another player reveals an illegal Draw hand. That player must discard one non-Home card he or she controls in play, discard the illegal Draw hand, then draw five cards to form a new Draw hand. The player must continue discarding a card and redrawing until a legal Draw hand is revealed or the player has no cards left to discard. Only one Cheatin'! card can be played against a player per draw.

name: Legal Offices of _________
text: Private. Controller Noon: Pay 3 ghost rock to give the Legal Offices a +1 Control Point bonus until after Nightfall. Each player can use this action up to twice per turn.

name: Lonesome Willow Strike
text: Private. Strike.

name: Los Diablos Stampede
text: The Dude (or Dudes) in play with the highest value is chased by the Stampede. Pull for each Dude being chased; If the pull is less than or equal to the dude's Bullet rating, the Dude is booted. If the pull is greater than the Dude's Bullet rating, but less than the Dude's value, the Dude goes into his or her owner's hand. If the pull is neither of the above, the Dude is aced. Ace this card.

name: Mordecai Whateley
text: You may not attach a weapon to Mordecai. Noon: Boot Mordecai and pay 3 GR. Search your deck (but not discard pile) for any one hex. Show the hex to the other players and place it in your hand. Shuffle your deck. Discard one card from your hand.

name: Pox Walker
text: Abomination. Noon: One dude in this location has his value reduced by three permanently. If this reduces the dude's value below one, the dude is aced.

name: Pride
text: Pride will not leave a Shootout without a card effect.

name: Revival Comes to Town
text: All Blessed have their Influence increased by their Blessed rating until after nightfall. Blessed do not straighten during nightfall this turn. Ace this card.

name: SUZY 309
text: Gadget Dude Difficulty: 8. SUZY cannot begin the game in play. To bring SUZY into play, you must make a skill Pull as if SUZY were a Gadget being attached to one of your Mad Scientists. SUZY enters play in the Scientist's location.

name: Sanctify
text: Noon Miracle 3: If this Miracle is successful, all Terrors in this location are sent home booted. Noon Miracle 10: If this Miracle is successful, Terrors may not move to this location for the rest of the game.

name: Seductress
text: Noon: Boot any one dude in play.

name: Skin Shifter
text: Abomination. Reaction: When a dude is sent to Boot Hill from this location, the Skin Shifter can copy the Influence, Bullet Rating, or one action printed on that dude until after nightfall next turn.

name: Smite
text: Shootout Miracle X: The difficulty of this Miracle is an opposing dude's Value plus Bullets. If this Miracle is successful, the target is booted then sent home. If this Miracle is successful by more than 6 points, the target is aced as well. If you pull an ace or joker, the blessed loses the Blessed trait, permanently.

name: Snake Handlin'
text: Shootout Miracle 5: If this Miracle is successful, a Snake (dude) is created as a member of this posse with a 0 Draw bullet rating. The Snake is removed from play at the end of this Shootout. Shootout Miracle 9: As above, but the Snake has a 1 Stud bullet rating.

name: Sonic Destabilitization Ray
text: Gadget Difficulty: 6. Noon Pull: Target a dude in play at the same location or adjacent to the dude carrying the ray. The target's value is reduced to the pull's value until after nightfall. If the pull is greater than the target's value, the ray has no effect.

name: Stagecoach Office
text: Controller Noon: Ace a card from your hand to gain 1 GR. There is no limit to the number of times that you may perform this action.

name: Supplies from Back East
text: Noon: Unboot one deed you own. You may use any action on that deed an additional time this turn.

name: Surveyor's Office
text: Private. Whenever a Deed with Production greater than 3 enters play, the owner of the Surveyor's Office gains 1 ghost rock.

name: Tastes Like Chicken
text: Noon: Boot any harrowed dude in play to ace any non-gadget horse at the same or an adjacent location.

name: The Flock
text: GR: 19 Any strikes with Control Points are worth an extra Control Point while you control them.

name: The Intelligence Shop
text: Controller Noon: Boot to raise a dude's Influence by one until after nightfall.

name: We've Got Ya Surrounded
text: Shootout: If you have more than twice as many dudes in your posse than the opposing posse, all of the dudes in your posse are studs until the end of this Shootout.

name: Wrath
text: Reaction: Cancel any one Shootout action card played during a Shootout with Wrath in the Shootout.

name: Barkum & Barkum Attorneys
text: Private. Controller Noon Pull: Boot the Attorneys and target and boot one of your Wanted Dudes. If the pull is less than or equal to the Dude's value, the Dude is no longer Wanted.

name: Basil Whateley
text: Noon Pull: Boot Basil and target one dude in play. If the pull plus Basil's Huckster skill are greater than the dude's value, the dude is booted.

name: Billy No-Neck
text: May not have any weapons.

name: Blood Curse
text: Noon Hex 8: Target a Dude. If this Hex succeeds, the Dude has a -1 Bullet penalty and a -1 Influence penalty (minimum 0) until after Nightfall. Shootout Hex 9: Target a Dude in this shootout. If this Hex succeeds, the Dude has a -2 Bullet penalty (minimum 0) until after Nightfall.

name: Bronco Bjork Gutmansen
text: Horses being attached to Bjork have their cost reduced by four. Bronco Bjork will not trade away a horse he has attached.

name: Buckets Nelson
text: Shootout: Discard a card from your hand to create one shark in Nelson's posse if this Shootout is taking place at an out-of-town location. The shark is a dude with a one-Bullet Stud rating The shark is removed from play after the Shootout is over. Nelson can perform this action any number of times per turn.

name: Byron St. James
text: You cannot move St. James to any location that contains Howard Findley.

name: Callahan's Ditch
text: Private. Strike.

name: Circus Sideshow
text: Charlie Landers goes to his controller's discard pile if he is in play. Until nightfall, all Draw Hands are drawn from the opposing Player's deck. Cards from Draw Hands are discarded into their owner's discard pile.

name: Deputize
text: Noon: All of your Dudes not in your Outfit become members of your Outfit. They remain members of any other Outfit to which they belong.

name: Dolores Whateley
text: Noon: Target a Dude. Boot Dolores to give the Dude a -1 Bullet penalty until after nightfall. Noon: Discard a black card to give Dolores a +2 Bullet bonus and increase her Huckster rating by 2, until after nightfall.

name: Eagle Rock
text: Will not call out a Sioux.

name: Foreclosure
text: Cheatin'! Reaction: Play when another player reveals an illegal Draw hand. Target and discard one Deed owned by that player. Only one Cheatin! Card can be played against a player per draw.

name: Forgery
text: Noon: Play a deed out of your hand that matches a deed in play. The deed in play is aced and your deed enters play normally. All dudes that were at the deed are moved to yours, without booting.

name: Greased Lightning Pill
text: Gadget Difficulty: 4. Shootout: Ace the Pill to give this dude +3 Bullets until the end of this Shootout.

name: Helpin' Hand
text: Reaction Hex X: Boot this Huckster when a dude is aced. The difficulty of this hex is equal to the Dude's value plus Influence plus bullets. If the hex is successful, the Dude is not aced, but is moved home booted.

name: His Back Was to Me
text: Shootout: Reduce the Bullet Rating of one opposing dude to be equal to the highest Bullet Rating in your posse. If you do not have any Studs in your posse, the target becomes a Draw bonus fighter as well. The reduction is only for this round of the Shootout.

name: Independence Day
text: All government buildings are booted except for a Jail and give no bonuses or production this turn. Boot Lucky Ted(s). Ace this card.

name: It's Just Coal…
text: Noon: Target one player, who loses 2 ghost rock. Ace this card.

name: King Willy's Mother Lode
text: Private. Strike.

name: Lord Grimely's Manor
text: Raise the Fear level by one while the Manor is in play. Players other than the Manor is in play. Players other than the Manor's owner may not gain control of the Manor or Deeds adjacent to the Manor. While the Fear Level is 10, you have one additional Control Point

name: Manitou's Revenge
text: Reaction: Play when a Spell fails. Target the Dude casting the Spell and pull: If the pull is lower than the Spell's Difficulty, the Dude is aced.

name: Mind Twist
text: Noon Hex X: Boot this Huckster. The difficulty of this Hex is three times the target's Influence. If the hex is successful, the target in play has his or her Influence reduced by two (minimum zero) until after nightfall.

name: Missed Me!
text: Shootout Hex 5: If this hex is successful, then one is subtracted form the number of dudes in your posse that must be aced in this round of the combat.

name: Missing Children
text: All Whateleys in play with the Huckster skill have a +1 Bullet Rating this turn.

name: Nicodemus Whateley
text: Noon: Boot Nicodemus when he is in the same location as an Abomination. You control the Abomination until after nightfall.

name: Nowhere to Run
text: Reaction: Play when a posse is trying to escape a Shootout. They are stuck in the Shootout and must fight another round.

name: Pacific Maze Railstation
text: Public. The Railstation's Production is equal to the number of Maze Rats in play. Controller Reaction: When a Goods enters play, boot the Railstation to increase or reduce its ghost rock cost by 2.

name: Pierre Fontaine
text: Noon: Move Pierre from one out-of-town deed to another, This does not boot Pierre.

name: Sam Horowitz
text: Cards with "Dynamite" or "Bomb" in their title have no Ghost Rock cost when being attached to Horowitz. Noon: Boot Horowitz. The deed where he is located produces no Ghost Rock until after Nightfall next turn, and Horowitz cannot perform any actions until after nightfall this turn.

name: Samhain
text: Harrowed dudes aced this turn are returned to play immediately to the controller's home booted (no pull necessary). All Terrors gain +1 Bullet bonus for this turn. Raise the Fear Level by one. Ace this card.

name: Saul Whateley
text: Reaction: Boot Saul as the target for a hex is being selected to redirect the hex to any other legal target.

name: Shadow Walk
text: Noon Hex 4: If this hex is successful, move this huckster to any location in play. Reaction Hex 6: If this Hex is successful when a posse is being formed or moved, then this Huckster joins the posse regardless of location.

name: Sheila Mirabella
text: You can attach goods to Sheila while she is at a strike you do not control. Noon: Boot Sheila and pay 2 ghost rock to get any one goods card from your deck. Show the card to the other players and attach it to Sheila. You must meet all normal restrictions and costs.

name: Sheriff's Watchin'
text: Reaction: Play immediately before one or more Dudes begin an action that could make them Wanted, or start a job that will take effect at another player's private location. The action is cancelled without effect.

name: Shotgun
text: Weapon. Shootout: Target a Dude in the opposing posse whose value is less than or equal to this Dude’s Bullet rating. Ace the target Dude.

name: Smith & Robards Delivery
text: Noon: You may put one gadget into play as a Noon action this turn. You must still pay the cost of the gadget and test to make sure it works (as if a Mad Scientist:1 were bringing the gadget into play). This gadget can be attached to any dude that may legally accept it.

name: Soul Blast
text: Shootout Hex X: Target an opposing Dude. X is the value plus Bullet rating of the Dude. If this Hex succeeds, send the Dude home booted. If the skill check exceeds the Difficulty by more than 5, ace the Dude instead. If you pull an ace or Joker, the Huckster is also aced.

name: Stray Lead
text: Reaction: Play immediately after hands have been revealed in a Shootout when a player has won by more ranks than the losing posse has dudes. The Player winning this Shootout has killed an innocent person-until the end of the game, he or she is always considered to have one fewer control points than he or she actually does.

name: Texas Twister
text: Noon Hex 5: Target an unbooted Dude at an adjacent location. If this Hex succeeds, boot the Dude. Noon Hex X: Target an unbooted Dude in play. X is the value plus Influence of the Dude. If this Hex succeeds, boot the Dude.

name: The Clock Tower
text: Public. The controller of The Clock Tower gets one Shootout action per round before Shootout actions would normally begin.

name: The Witching Hour
text: Noon: Boot more of your Hucksters than the current Fear Level to raise the Fear Level by one. Ace this card.

name: They Just Pay Better 'n You
text: Noon: Play a dude out of your hand that matches a non-unique dude in play (but not in Boot Hill). Your dude enters play (ghost rock costs are waived), and the opposing dude is discarded with an goods he may have. Any permanent effects carry over to your dude.

name: Unknown Hooded Figure
text: Abomination. You must have a member of the Whateley Outfit in play to bring the Figure into play or use it's Reaction. The figure can start the game in play. Reaction: The first time it is aced in a game, return the Figure home Harrowed as your first action next high Noon, and give it a permanent +1 Bullet bonus.

name: Werewolf
text: Abomination. You may not bring the Werewolf into play through normal means. Goods cannot be attached to the Werewolf. Noon Pull: Boot the Werewolf. If the pull is Black, put a Lycanthrope dude into play from your Hand in the Werewolf's location. Put the Werewolf into your Hand, discarding attached goods. You may only perform this action if the Fear level is below 8.

name: Werner Braun
text: Proprietor of the 1st Bank of Gomorra

name: Whateley Family Estate
text: GR: 17 Noon: Boot one of your Hucksters who is at a location where a dude was aced this turn. Your dude's Huckster skill is permanently increased by one.

name: Wilhelmina Whateley
text: If Wilhelmina ever dies, Whateley dudes in play can not take ant actions this turn. Wilhelmina cannot move out of town. Noon: Boot Wilhelmina and pay ghost rock to produce combat bonuses. Each ghost rock paid gives +1 Bullet bonus to a dude you control until after nightfall. No dude can receive more than a +2 Bullet bonus.

name: Yer Cheatin' Too!
text: Reaction: Play when another player plays a Cheatin! Card targeting you and they also have an illegal hand for this draw. Your opponent's Cheatin! Card is canceled and has no effects.

name: A Coach Comes to Town
text: Starting with the Winner and going clockwise, one of your opponent's Dudes can start a job to rob the stage in the Town Square. You can form a posse to defend it if you wish. If the job succeeds, pay that player 4 ghost rock, or your total ghost rock if you have less than 4. If nobody attacks the stage or the job fails, you gain 4 ghost rock from the Bank.

name: A Price on His Head
text: Noon: Choose any one Wanted dude in play. Until the end of the game any Player that aces the dude in a Shootout gets 5 ghost rock.

name: Abandoned Mine
text: Private. Strike. Only Terrors can move to the Abandoned Mine.

name: And Stay Down!
text: Reaction: Play immediately before a Harrowed Dude is aced. Target the Dude, who is aced and automatically sent to Boot Hill - no Harrowed pull is made

name: Arizona Jane
text: Noon: Boot Jane to move her to a location you own but do not control. Jane calls out one dude at that location.

name: Arson
text: Noon Job: Boot one of your Dudes to start a job that targets a Deed. If the job succeeds, pull: if the pull is black, the Deed is aced and all Dudes in your posse become Wanted.

name: Bad Tequila
text: Noon: Target an unbooted Dude with Influence less than 2. Boot the Dude.

name: Benny Hibbs
text: Reaction: Boot Benny to reduce the cost of a gadget by two as it is being brought into play.

name: Black Jack
text: Black Jack is always wanted

name: Blackjacks
text: GR: 19 Noon: Target and boot one of your Blackjacks Dudes to gain 2 ghost rock. The Dude becomes Wanted. This action can be used any number of times per turn.

name: Blacksmith
text: +1 ghost rock production for each Mad Scientist dude in play, to a maximum total production of +3.

name: Bluff
text: Reaction: Play immediately after players have revealed their Draw Hands. Discard yours and draw five new cards which becomes your new Draw Hand.

name: Brawl
text: Noon: Target any location. Until after nightfall, any dude in that location can as a Noon action start a Shootout with any other dude at that location. This is not "Calling Out". Any dude aced for losing a round of the Shootout goes home booted instead of being aced. Normal shootouts at this location resolve normally.

name: Bucket Brigade
text: Reaction: Play immediately before a Deed is aced. The Deed is not aced, but actions on the Deed cannot be used for the rest of this turn and the Deed produces no ghost rock until after Nightfall next turn.

name: Bullet-Proof Vest
text: Gadget Difficulty: 3. This dude cannot be aced as a result of a Draw hand rank in a Shootout unless his or her Draw Hand is beaten by at least two Ranks. Continue the Shootout for another round, if necessary.

name: Casino Morongo
text: Dudes aced in a Shootout in the Morongo do not go to Boot Hill - they go to there Owner's discard pile, instead.

name: Cassidy Greene
text: If you control a saloon you may bring Cassidy into play for free at the saloon. Noon: Give a +1 Bullet bonus until the end of the turn to any other dude at the same deed as Cassidy. The Dude keeps the bonus even if he or she moves.

name: Caught with Yer Pants Down
text: Shootout: Select one dude in this Shootout, who may gain no benefit from any goods for this Shootout, and receives a -1 Bullet for this Shootout (minimum zero).

name: Cave-in
text: Noon: Choose one strike in play. That strike is booted and produces no ghost rock; it may not unboot until a dude boots there as a Noon action.

name: Charlie Landers
text: Charlie cannot be called out or move to a location you do not control. Noon: Boot Charlie when he is in a Saloon to dispense free drinks, resulting in a -1 Bullet penalty (minimum 0) until after Nightfall, for all other Dudes in the same Saloon as Charlie.

name: Cheatin' Varmint
text: Cheatin'! Reaction: Play when another Player reveals an illegal Draw Hand. His Draw Hand is reduced by three ranks from it's actual value (and is considered the worst possible hand of that Rank). Only one Cheatin' card can be played against a Player per draw.

name: Christmas Day
text: No calling out or jobs may take place during this turn. Once during this turn, each player may put into play for free any one goods card that they hold in their Play Hand. Ace this card.

name: Claim Jumper
text: Noon: Target a Strike you control. Boot one of your Dudes at the Strike to become the owner of the Strike until it leaves play. If the Strike leaves play, ownership immediately returns to its original owner.

name: Claims Office
text: The Owner gains 1 ghost rock each time a player puts a strike into play. Controller Reaction: Boot and play 2 ghost rock to prevent the purchase of any strike deed. The deed is returned to the top of that players deck, and the ghost rock is returned to the players vault.

name: Clean Up the Town
text: Noon: Target a Wanted Dude in town. Boot one of your Dudes to call out the target Dude, at his or her location. If the Dude refuses, his or her Influence is permanently reduced to 0 and cannot be increased by any means for the rest of the game. If a Dude with 0 Influence refuses, the Dude is aced.

name: Clell Miller
text: Clell Miller gains a permanent +1 Bullet Bonus every time his posse aces another dude with a higher Bullet Rating in a Shootout.

name: Cletus Peacock
text: Cletus gains a +2 Bullet bonus for that shoot out when he calls someone out.

name: Collegium
text: GR: 17 You have one additional Control Point for every Gadget in play with Gadget Difficulty higher than four.

name: Colorado Lode
text: Private. Strike. You can ace any one Strike with Production less than 3 when you bring this card into play. If you ace a Strike you control, reduce the ghost rock cost of this Strike by the Production of the one you aced.

name: Cordelia "Corky" Hendricks
text: Shootout Pull: If the pull is red, Corky gets a +2 Bullet bonus for this Shootout. If it's black, she gets a -1 Bullet penalty (min zero) for this Shootout. Corky can do this action once per Shootout.

name: Crack Shot
text: Shootout: Target a Draw Dude in this shootout. The Dude is a Stud until the end of the shootout.

name: Dead Man's Hand
text: Noon: Boot one of your dudes who calls out any target booted dude in play. The target dude must accept and enter the shootout, which occurs at the target's location. If your dude has a lower Bullet rating than the target's printed Bullet rating, raise your Dude's Bullet rating to be equal to the target's.  If your dude survives the Shootout, he or she becomes Wanted.

name: Deputy John Templeton
text: Templeton gets a +2 Bullet bonus while anyone in an opposing posse in a shootout has a lower value.

name: Dispatch Office
text: Private.  All of the Dispatch Office controller's Dudes at this location with Influence greater than 0 have a +1 Influence bonus while at this location.

name: Diversion
text: Reaction: Play this card when a dude is booting to join a posse. That dude does not boot and cannot join the posse for the rest of the shootout. This does not stop a dude from starting a posse.

name: Don't Like Yer Looks
text: Noon: Target a Dude in the Town Square or at any Deed you control. Boot one of your Dudes at the same location to call out the target Dude. The target cannot refuse and no other Dudes can join the Shootout.

name: Double Dealin'
text: Cheatin'! Reaction: Play when another player reveals an illegal Draw hand. That player's entire Draw hand is discarded and replaced by the top five cards of your deck. Your cards are discarded normally afterwards. Only one Cheatin' card can be played against a player per draw.

name: Dragon's Nest Strike
text: Private. Strike. The Dude or Dudes in play with the lowest value are aced when this Strike is put into play from your Play hand.

name: Drawing a Bead
text: Shootout: Target one of your dudes in a Shootout. Gain no benefit for this dude in this round. Triple the Bullet rating for this dude in all consecutive rounds of the Shootout.

name: Drop in the Ocean Strike
text: Private. Strike.

name: Dust Devil
text: Noon: Target and ace a Goods card in play.

name: Dynamite Launcher
text: Weapon. Gadge Difficulty: 5. Noon Job: If successful, boot this dude to ace the Launcher and the deed this dude is at. Pull: If the value is less than the dude's value he is returned home, otherwise he is aced.

name: Earthquake
text: All strikes in play that produce less than 3 ghost rock per turn are destroyed.

name: Easter Sunday
text: Each Player can pull for each one of his or her dudes that was aced last turn. If the pull is red, the dude returns to play at your home, unbooted. If the dude was Harrowed before, he or she remains Harrowed; otherwise, he or she returns to play as a normal, non-Harrowed dude.  Ace this card.

name: Eddie Bellows
text: Eddie can never have a Bullet Rating higher than two. Shootout: Boot Eddie to look at the hand of an opponent who has dudes at this Shootout.

name: Erik Zarkov
text: Shootout Pull: Target a Weapon Gadget attached to Erik. If the pull is a ♣, ace Erik. Otherwise the Gadget gains a +3 Bullet bonus until the end of the shootout.

name: Eureka!
text: Eureka enters play attached to your gang. Whenever Eureka attaches to a Players Gang, that player draws two cards and adds them to his or her Play Hand. A Players maximum hand size is increased by 2 while Eureka is attached. Eureka leaves his player whenever a dude that player controls is aced and attaches to the next player on the left. If multiple dudes are aced simultaneously, Eureka! moves only once. Only one Eureka can be in play at a time.

name: Exchange Office
text: Controller Noon: Boot the Exchange Office to gain 1 ghost rock for every deed in play that produces more than 3 ghost rock.

name: Extortion
text: Noon: Target a deed that you currently control but do not own. You maintain control of this deed until another player, as a Noon action, pays you ghost rock equal to the amount of Influence that you had at that location when you played this card. At that point, control of the deed is determined normally.

name: Fanning the Hammer
text: Reaction: Play when Draw hands are compared in a shootout and your posse has won the round. The opposing posse takes two additional casualties.

name: Father Juan Navarro
text: Father Juan cannot use the Blackjack home's ability to gain 2 ghost rock. Shootout: Boot Father Juan to remove him from this shootout and send him home.

name: Fineas von Landingham
text: Noon: Boot von Landingham to gain 2 ghost rock, brought in by airship from a secret mine in the Badlands.

name: Foale's Folly
text: Private. Strike.

name: Founder's Day
text: You gain 2 ghost rock.

name: Framed
text: The ghost rock cost of this card is double the target's Influence. Noon: Target one dude in play who becomes Wanted. That dude's controller may as a Noon action, boot a Law Dog he controls to Pull: if the pull is a red card, the dude is no longer Wanted and that Player can choose one of your dudes who become wanted instead.

name: Friends in Low Places
text: Noon: Look at one of your opponents' Play Hands.

name: Fu Leng's Laundry and Tailoring
text: Fu Leng's cost is reduced by 2 if you have Tao Cheng in play.

name: Full Moon
text: Choose a Dude and pull: If the pull is greater than the Dudes value, you gain control of the Dude until after Nightfall, but his or her Upkeep cost is tripled until after Nightfall. If you do not pay the Upkeep, the Dude is immediately returned to his or her original controller. Ace this card.

name: Gatling Pistol
text: Gadget Difficulty: 3.

name: Gettin' Outta Hand
text: Reaction: Play just after a dude performs an action and is at a deed you control. One of your dudes at that location may call out the acting dude who must accept the challenge. No other dudes may join this Shootout.

name: Giddyup!
text: Reaction: Play when one of your Dudes boots to join a posse. Your Dude does not boot to join the posse.

name: Git!
text: Noon Pull: If the pull value is greater than the value of the target dude at one of your deeds, start a Shootout that may not be refused between that dude and one of your dudes at the same location. Any dudes adjacent to the deed may join either side of the Shootout. Dudes not actually in the targets location must boot to join in the posse.

name: Golden Mare Hotel
text: Public. Brothel. The owner gains 1 ghost rock each time a Dude is put into play from someone's Play hand. Ghost rock is not gained from token Dudes.

name: Grave Robbin'
text: Noon: Get one ghost rock for each dude buried in Boot Hill.

name: Graveyard
text: Private. The Graveyard's owner gains 3 ghost rock each time a Dude is aced. Controller Reaction: When a Dude becomes Harrowed, boot the Graveyard to negate the effect. The Dude is not Harrowed.

name: Gremlins
text: Noon: Target one Gadget in play. The Gadget is aced. Noon: Boot a Mad Scientist in play.

name: Hangin' Judge Gabriel
text: No warrants or bounties can be issued for Gabriel. Gabriel cannot be wanted. Noon: Boot to ace any Wanted dude if Gabriel is in the same location or adjacent. Ace Gabriel after he "claims" a Wanted dude.

name: Haunting
text: Noon: Play on any deed which has its' ghost rock production cut in half (round down). The deed gains the Badlands trait while haunted. The Haunting will end when a Blessed or Shaman dude at this deed is booted as a Noon action.

name: Head 'em Off at the Pass
text: Reaction: Play immediately before a posse is formed for a job. Target one of your Dudes, who can join the posse regardless of the Dude's location and whether or not the Dude is booted. Movement restrictions still apply.

name: Headsman's Axe
text: Reaction: Play immediately after a Dude is aced. The Dude cannot be brought into play again through any means.

name: Heavy Rain
text: Until after nightfall, dudes and posses may not move or ride farther than adjacent locations by any means.

name: Hector Casparo
text: Reaction: After Draw hands are revealed, you can discard a card from your Draw hand and redraw one card when Casparo is gambling (as a result of a card effect) or in a Shootout.

name: Hell's Fury
text: Noon Pull: Choose a dude in any Boot Hill that you also hold in your Play hand. If the value of the pull is higher than the Dude's value, remove the dude in Boot Hill from the game and bring your Dude into play without cost. This Dude is now harrowed.

name: Hideout
text: When this deed is brought into play choose any one deed out of town that this deed is "adjacent to". Your posse gets a +1 Draw bonus when defending the Hideout, and always gets the first Shootout action.

name: Humphrey Walters
text: Town Founder. Lycanthrope. Shootout Pull: You can use this ability once per shootout. If the pull is red, put the Werewolf into play unbooted and under your control from your hand in place of Humphrey and put Humphrey into your play hand. Humphrey  and the Werewolf are different Dudes for uniqueness purposes. All attached cards are discarded. If a Full Moon has occurred this turn, this pull is automatically red.

name: Ignore 'im
text: Shootout: Remove one of your dudes from this Shootout. Your dude is sent home booted.

name: J.P. Coleman
text: The Town Sheriff. Coleman costs 5 less ghost rock to enter play from your Play hand or for upkeep if the Fear Level is higher than five. (*Coleman is also a member of The Agency.)

name: Jail
text: Private. Government. When a player aces a Wanted Dude, the player can put the Dude in Jail, collecting a bounty of half the Dude's ghost rock cost (round down). The Dude is not aced, but is out of play except for uniqueness. Any player can target the Jail with a Noon job - if successful, the player can send any number of jailed Dudes home booted. If the Jail leaves play, Dudes in it go home booted.

name: Jessie Freemont
text: Jessie will not call out a Law Dog.

name: Joker
text: This card can only be used for Draw hands and pulls. Ace this card after it is used.  The Joker is a wildcard: the player who draws it determines its suit and value. You may not have more than two Jokers in a deck. This card does not count against your deck limit.

name: Just a Graze
text: Reaction: Play immediately after Draw hands have been compared in a shootout. Your posse takes one less casualty.

name: Kenny
text: Sidekick. While Kenny is attached to a Dude in a shootout, he is a Dude in the posse with a 0 Draw Bullet rating. If Kenny is removed from the shootout, he becomes booted, remains attached to the same Dude, and is no longer a Dude. If Kenny is killed in a shootout, he is aced (not discarded).

name: LAD Saloon
text: Public. Saloon. Any Dude called out at the LAD Saloon has a +1 Bullet bonus for the shootout.

name: Lady Luck
text: Noon: You can discard as many of your cards as you like during Nightfall this turn.

name: Law Dogs
text: GR: 19 You get one Victory Point every time you put another player's Wanted dude into Jail, and every time you ace a Wanted dude who has more than one Influence.

name: Lilith Vandekamp
text: Noon: Boot Lilith to gain 2 ghost rock if she is in a saloon or brothel.

name: Lucky Ted
text: Reaction: If Ted is in the same posse as a dude about to be aced, you may ace Ted instead.

name: Lynch Mob
text: Noon: Choose any one Wanted dude. Any Player may boot as many un-Wanted dudes they wish to join the mob. If the number of dudes in the lynch mob is greater than the combined Bullet Rating of the Wanted dude's gang at his location, then he is aced.

name: Marcus Perriwinkle
text: Non-Unique. Gadgets created by Marcus have their ghost rock cost reduced by 2.

name: Mechanical Horse
text: Horse. Gadget Difficulty: 4. Noon: Boot the Horse to move this dude to any other location. Reaction: Boot the Horse instead of this dude when joining the posse.

name: Meredith Singleton
text: Noon: Boot Meredith to boot any non-terror dude at the same location.

name: Mick Caples
text: Reaction: When you put a strike in play, boot Mick and Pull: If it is a face card, the strike has +1 production. If it is a Joker, the strike has +2 production. These changes are permanent.

name: Miner's Union House
text: The Union House's Controller never has his strike's production decreased when he is both the Owner and Controller of the Strike. The Production of the Union House is equal to the number of strikes in play.

name: Nash Bilton
text: Noon: Nash calls out one dude at this location. He may perform this action while booted.

name: Nasty Doc's
text: Reaction: Boot Doc's and ace any non-Terror Dude you control to Harrow a dude who has just been aced. If you didn't control the dude before, you do now.

name: Nice Boots, Chief
text: Reaction: Play when an opposing Dude is aced in a shootout. Take a Goods from that Dude and attach it to one of your Dudes that was in the shootout.

name: Old Moon Saloon
text: Saloon. Anytime another player reveal an illegal Draw Hand, the Owner of the Old Moon Saloon gains 1 Ghost Rock.

name: Oswald Hardinger
text: Reaction: Boot Oswald as a Gadget is producing an action to cancel the action. Shootout: Boot Oswald to reduce a weapon Gadget's bonus to zero. Only affects weapons in a Shootout Oswald is in.

name: Out of Ammo
text: Shootout: Target a Stud Dude in this shootout. The Dude is a Draw until the end of the shootout.

name: Pannin' for Gold
text: Reaction: Play when a Strike is aced to receive ghost rock equal to the amount that the strike would normally produce.

name: Pearl-Handled Revolver
text: Weapon. This Dude is a Stud while in a shootout.

name: Perry's Pawnshop
text: Controller Noon: Boot the Pawnshop and ace a goods card you control to gain ghost rock equal to half of that card's ghost rock (round down).

name: Pharmacy
text: Controller Noon: Boot the Pharmacy and pay two ghost rock to unboot a dude at an adjacent location.

name: Photographer Shop
text: Controller Reaction: Boot the Photographer Shop when a dude is brought into play to gain ghost rock equal to the dudes Influence.

name: Pike's Puddle Mine
text: Private. Strike.

name: Pinto
text: Horse. Shootout: Boot the Pinto to remove this dude from this Shootout. Move this dude to any out of town deed you control (or home if you have no out of town deeds). This dude is booted. Pull: If the value is greater than your dude's value, the Pinto is aced at the end of the ride.

name: Pony Express
text: Controller Noon: Boot to discard a card and draw a new one.

name: Prof. Parnham's Miracle Elixir
text: Gadget Difficulty: 4. Reaction: Use the Elixir when this dude is aced to ace the Elixir instead. The Dude is not aced and goes home booted.

name: Quickdraw
text: Reaction: Play in the event of a tie (the same Hand Rank) in a Shootout to win the Shootout by one Rank.

name: Raid
text: Noon Job: One of your dudes gathers a posse to raid your opponents Vault at his or her home. If the Raid is successful, Pull the top card from your opponents deck and take an amount of ghost rock equal to half (round up) from the target Player. All dudes in your posse are wanted.

name: Ray Gun
text: Weapon. Gadget Difficulty: 6 This Gadget has no ghost rock cost if being attached to Erik Zarkov.

name: Roan
text: Horse. Reaction: Boot the Roan instead of this Dude when riding to a new location. You cannot move a booted Dude in this fashion.

name: Robert Holmes
text: Noon: Boot Holmes to retrieve any one Gadget from Boot Hill and shuffle it into your deck.

name: Rock Ridge Mine
text: Private. Strike.

name: Rocket Pack
text: Horse. Gadget: 6. Shootout: Move this Dude to the location of the shootout. The Dude joins your posse. Shootout: Boot the Rocket Pack to leave this shootout and move home. Noon: Boot the Rocket Pack to move this Dude to a different location.

name: Run Outta Town
text: Cheatin'! Reaction: Play when another Player reveals an illegal Draw Hand. Target any one dude controlled by that player. Pull: If the value is equal to or higher than the dude's value, the dude is discarded along with any goods he controls. Only one Cheatin'! Card can be played against a player per draw.

name: Sam's General Store
text: Controller Reaction: Boot to reduce by 2 the cost of any goods cards you are putting into play.

name: San Simeon Mine
text: Private. Strike.

name: Sandra Harris
text: Noon: Look at a random card in another Players Play Hand.

name: Scalpin'
text: Reaction: Play when one of your dudes just Aced someone else's Dude during a shootout or with an action. Your dude permanently gains Influence equal to one half of the aced dude's Influence (round down).

name: Schoolhouse
text: Public. Government. Schoolhouse may not enter play if the fear level is above 3.

name: Scrapyard
text: All of your Gadgets cost 1 less ghost rock to bring into play while you control the Scrapyard.

name: Shortcut
text: Reaction: Play when one of your Dudes is moving to a new location (not as part of a posse). This move does not boot your Dude.

name: Snake Eyes
text: Reaction: Play immediately after a pull is revealed. The pull is discarded and the player making the pull redraws.

name: Spirit of Kentucky Shaft
text: Private. Strike.

name: St. Martin's Chapel
text: Public. Holy Ground. Terrors cannot move to St. Martin's Chapel or call out a Dude in it.

name: Still
text: Noon: Boot the Still and this dude to boot any other dude in play with a lower value than your dude. Noon Pull: Boot the Still. This dude permanently changes his value into the value of the pull. If the pull was an ace, the Still and this dude are aced.

name: Sun in Yer Eyes
text: Shootout: Target a Dude in the opposing posse. The Dude has a -2 Bullet penalty (minimum 0) until the end of the shootout.

name: Sweaty Dynamite
text: Noon Pull: If the pull is a ♣, ace this Dude. Otherwise, boot this Dude and attach the Dynamite to this Deed. Any Dude can start a Noon job that targets the Dynamite - if the job succeeds, the Dynamite is aced. If the Dynamite is still attached to the Deed after Nightfall, ace the Deed and discard the Dynamite.

name: Tao Cheng ("T.C.")
text: Shootout: T.C. gets a +2 Bullet bonus in a Shootout if none of the opponents are carrying a weapon.

name: The 1st Bank of Gomorra
text: Public. Other players cannot take ghost rock from the controller of the 1st Bank. If control of the 1st Bank changes, the new controller takes half of the old controllers ghost rock (round down). All Dudes have a -1 Influence penalty (min zero) while at the 1st Bank.

name: The Alright Corral
text: Private. Any non-Gadget Horse you put into play has its ghost rock cost reduced by 3.

name: The Courthouse
text: Public. Government. Only a Law Dog can move to The Courthouse. Controller Noon: Target a Wanted Dude. Boot The Courthouse to make the Dude un-Wanted. Controller Noon: Target a Dude in Jail. Boot The Courthouse to ace the Dude - card effects cannot prevent the Dude from being aced.

name: The Desert Rose Lode
text: Private. Strike.

name: The Sabbath
text: If the Fear Level is less than 4, all Terrors are booted and cannot unboot or perform actions this turn.

name: The Slaughterhouse
text: Private. Controller Noon: Boot The Slaughterhouse to remove any Dude in Boot Hill from play. The Dude cannot be brought into play by any player for the rest of this game.

name: The Tree
text: Public. Any Dudes at this location are considered adjacent to all Deeds in town but cannot be called out without a card effect.

name: The Undertaker's
text: Private. The Undertaker's controller gains 1 ghost rock every time a Dude is aced.

name: Tombstone Dispatch Branch Office
text: Private. The Branch Office counts as 1 Influence toward the controller's total. Controller Reaction: When an un-Wanted Dude becomes Wanted, boot the Branch Office to gain 2 ghost rock.

name: Town Hall
text: Controller Reaction: Boot Town Hall and one or more of your dudes to prevent a deed from entering play. Your dudes must have more total Influence than the ghost rock cost of the deed to perform this action. The deed is aced but no ghost rock is spent.

name: Vampiric Dance Hall Girl
text: Abomination. For each dude that is aced at the same location, she gains +1 Bullet until after nightfall.

name: Victor Navarro
text: Reaction: Boot Victor to join any Shootout immediately after Draw Hands are shown, if anyone in your gang are in the Shootout.

name: Warrant
text: Noon: Target an un-Wanted Dude. Boot one or more of your Dudes with a combined Influence greater than the Influence of the target. The target Dude becomes Wanted.

name: Winchester Rifle
text: Weapon

name: Wishing Well
text: Controller Noon: Boot the Wishing Well and spend 1 ghost rock. Pull: 2-5, get nothing; 6-8 get one ghost rock; 9-J get 2 ghost rock; Q-K get 3 ghost rock; A, get 4 ghost rock; Joker, lose 2 ghost rock (if possible).

name: Yellow Belly
text: Reaction: Play when a dude refuses when being called out. The dude is -1 Influence and -1 Bullet (Minimum zero) permanently.

name: Yer All Chicken!
text: Noon: Target one of your dudes in the Town Square. Each opposing Player may send one of their dudes for a Shootout with your dude, or else must give you one ghost rock. Begin with the player on your left and go clockwise once around the table. If your dude is aced by a challenger the remaining players do not have to pay you. No other dudes may join these Shootouts.

name: Avarice
text: Any location with Avarice in it has it's printed ghost rock production doubled. Noon: Boot Avarice to get any strike from your deck. Show it to the other players and place it in your hand. Shuffle your deck. Discard a card from your hand.

name: Benjamin Dean
text: Shootout: Target an opposing Terror. If the Terror is aced in the shootout, lower the Fear Level by 1 (minimum 1).

name: Bottom Dealin’
text: Reaction: Play when you are about to pull. Instead of drawing from the top of your deck, draw the top card of your discard.

name: Call Weather
text: Noon Spirit 6: If this Spirit is successful, no dude may move to the location until after nightfall. Noon Spirit 9: If this Spirit is successful, no dude may move to this location or the Town Square until after nightfall.

name: Calm
text: Shootout Miracle X: The difficulty of this Miracle is the value of the highest value dude in the opposing posse. If this Miracle is successful, the Shootout is cancelled, and both posses are sent home, booted.

name: Captain Sim Yut-San
text: Experienced. Noon: Target another Dude in play. Boot Captain Sim to reduce the Influence of Captain Sim and the target Dude to 0 until after Nightfall.

name: Censure
text: Reaction Miracle 5: Perform this Miracle immediately before a Huckster pulls to perform a hex. If this Miracle is successful, the pull is reduced by your Blessed's Value.

name: Chester Nero
text: Harrowed.

name: Chilling Effect
text: Reaction: Play immediately after a dude is brought into play. Target and boot one other dude in play controlled by a different player who has a value four or more below that of the dude who was brought into play.

name: Consecrate Armament
text: Noon Miracle 3: If this Miracle is successful, give a +1 bullet bonus and the Mystical trait to any one weapon in play until after nightfall. Noon Miracle 7: If this Miracle is successful, give a +2 bullet bonus and the Mystical trait to any one weapon in play until after nightfall.

name: Cort Williams
text: Terrors in the same location as Cort have their Influence reduced to 0. Shootout: Target and ace a Terror in this shootout.

name: Degeneration
text: Noon: Target a Harrowed dude in play. That dude loses 1 Bullet, 1 Influence, and one action printed on his card (your choice), permanently.

name: Drinks on the House
text: Reaction: Play immediately after an event has resolved. Until the end of the game, events with that name do not resolve when they appear. Ace this card.

name: Drought
text: For each Dude that any player unboots during Nightfall this turn, that player must pay 1 ghost rock, or the Dude remains booted.

name: Duplicator
text: Gadget Difficulty: 6. Noon Pull: Target a dude in play. If the pull is greater than or equal to the dude's value, then your dude gets to choose any one action on the target dude. Treat your dude as if he had that action printed on him until after nightfall.

name: Erik Zarkov
text: Experienced. Do not pull when Zarkov is creating a Weapon Gadget. The Gadget automatically works.

name: Gomorra Gazette
text: Controller Noon: Boot to increase one dude’s influence by one until after nightfall. Controller Noon: Boot and pay 2 ghost rock to decrease one dude’s Influence by one until after nightfall.

name: Good Stiff Drink
text: Noon: One action on a dude in play that has been used can be used a second time this turn.

name: Gus Gallagher
text: Noon: Move Gallagher and one other of your dudes at his location to any other location. This does not boot Gallagher or your other dude, but they must be unbooted to perform this action.

name: Hardinger’s Blueprints
text: Reaction: Ace the Blueprints instead of pulling when this Mad Scientest is bringing a Gadget into play. The Gadget automatically works.

name: Holy Roller
text: Noon Miracle 6: If this Miracle is successful, this Blessed gains a +1 Bullet and +1 Influence until after nightfall. Shootout Miracle 8: If this Miracle is successful, this Blessed cannot be aced in this shootout unless your hand is beaten by at least 3 ranks.

name: Home Sweet Home
text: Noon: Target one of your dudes who is at your home. That dude cannot be targeted with actions or jobs by any player (including you). That dude may not join a posse or move from home until after nightfall.

name: Johnny Quaid
text: Sweetrock dudes may not call out Quaid.

name: Josef Nicolai Rocescu
text: Shootout: If Rocescu has no weapons and there is an abomination in the opposing posse, Josef gains +4 bullets for the rest of this Shootout.

name: Knot Mine
text: Private. Strike. All Abominations at this location have a +1 Bullet rating. All Abominations at this location have a +1 Influence only for the purpose of controlling this location.

name: Lay on Hands
text: Reaction Miracle 8: When a Dude is aced, boot this Blessed. If this Miracle succeeds, the target Dude is not aced, but is sent home booted. If the Miracle fails, this Blessed cannot unboot this turn, and loses one Influence permanently (minimum zero).

name: Lost Faith
text: Reaction: Play when a Blessed's Miracle is unsuccessful. That dude loses the Blessed skill, permanently.

name: Machinist's Shop
text: Any Mad Scientist in the shop has his or her Mad Scientist skill increased by one.

name: Magnetic Poles Realign
text: All Gadgets in play are booted. No gadgets may be created this turn.  Gadgets cannot be used, and provide no bonuses (or control points) this turn. Ace this card.

name: Major Earthquake
text: All strikes with a production greater than 3 produce no ghost rock or control points this turn. Each player selects one strike owned by the player to his right; all selected strikes are discarded.

name: Martyr’s Cross
text: Mystical. Whenever one of your dudes is aced, the Cross provides a +1 Bullet, and +1 Influence until after nightfall to this dude, cumulatively.

name: Nash Bilton
text: Experienced. Nash will not call out a Sweetrock dude. Noon: Boot Nash to call out one dude at an adjacent location. The Shootout will take place in Nash's location - the target moves to this location.

name: Nate Hunter is Elected Sherrif
text: Nate Hunter gains 1 Influence permanently. Nash Bilton loses 1 Influence permanently. All-in town deeds with ghost rock production greater than zero produce one extra this turn. All strikes produce one fewer ghost rock this turn. Ace this card.

name: Pair of Six-Shooters
text: Weapon. Shootout: Look at the top five cards of your deck. You can either discard all five cards, or else place them back on top of your deck in the same order.

name: Philip Blackmoor
text: Noon Pull: Boot Blackmoor at a strike. If the pull is higher than the value of the strike, the production of this strike is permanently increased by one.

name: Sister Mary Jebediah
text: Terrors cannot target Sister Mary with actions.

name: Smoke Signals
text: Shootout: Move any or all of your unbooted Sioux dudes into this posse, regardless of their location. All of those dudes are booted.

name: Stuffed to the Gills Strike
text: Private. Strike. Raise the Fear Level by 2 while this Strike is in play.

name: Swapped Decks
text: Reaction: Play when someone plays a Cheatin’! card on you. Discard one card from your Draw hands and replace it with the top card of your deck. If your final Draw hand is now legal, the Cheatin’! card is discarded without effect.

name: Test of Faith
text: Shootout Miracle 5: If this Miracle is successful, this Blessed's bullet rating is increased to be equal to his or her Influence and becomes a stud, until the end of this shootout.

name: That’ll Leave a Scar
text: Reaction: Play after draw hands have been revealed for a Shootout, and immediately before hands are discarded. Ace any one card in your opponent’s Draw Hand. Pay 2 ghost rock or this card is also aced.

name: The Agency
text: GR: 17 You gain 1 Victory Point after Nightfall every time one of your Dudes aces a Terror in a shootout if the Terror has a value of 7 or more and ends the turn in Boot Hill.

name: The Carpenter’s Shop
text: All of the controller’s in town deeds cost 2 less ghost rock to put into play (minimum zero).

name: The Dentist’s Office
text: Private

name: The Ghost
text: Harrowed. Reaction: Cancel any one action immediately after it targets the Ghost (including calling him out), but before it is resolved.

name: Tin Shield
text: When the Tin Shield enters play, decide whether the Shield will make the Dude a Law Dog, Texas Ranger, or Agency. The Dude is considered a member of that Outfit while the Tin Shield is attached.

name: Tombstone Frank
text: Harrowed. Frank cannot be aced in a shootout unless your hand is beaten by at least 3 ranks.

name: Turtle's Shell
text: Shootout Spirit 6: If this Spirit is successful, then you can ace one less Dude (if you have to ace any) each round for the rest of this shootout.

name: Will o' the Wisp
text: Abomination. The Wisp cannot move to locations in town. Noon: Move the Will o' the Wisp to a strike. This does not boot the Wisp. Noon: Boot one dude at this location.

name: William Olson
text: Town Bailiff. The Bailiff gets a +2 Bullet bonus while in a Shootout against one or more Wanted dudes. The Bailiff gets a +2 Influence bonus while he is at the Courthouse or Jail.

name: A Secret Tunnel
text: Noon: Target two Deeds you own. A secret tunnel exists between those two Deeds. The Deeds are adjacent whenever you wish for the rest of the game

name: Ace in the Hole
