text: Reaction: Play immediately after Draw hands are revealed for any draw. Discard one card from your Draw hand and replace it with either a card from your Play hand or the top card of your deck

name: Ambush
text: Noon Job: Boot one of your Dudes to start a job that targets another player's Dude. If the job succeeds, the target Dude is aced (if still in play). All Dudes in your posse become Wanted unless the target was Wanted.

name: And Scooter
text: The cost to bring Scooter in play from your Play Hand and his upkeep are reduced by one if you have Big Jake in play.

name: Austin Stoker
text: Shootout: All Terrors in this Shootout with a Bullet Rating below 3 have their rating reduced to zero.

name: Big Jake…
text: The cost to bring Jake into play from your Play Hand and his upkeep are reduced by one if you have Scooter in play. Reaction: Boot Jake immediately before the upkeep phase to reduce the production of one strike to zero for this turn.

name: Bob's Fix-It Shop
text: Controller Reaction: Boot the Fix-It Shop when one of your gadgets is being aced to place the Gadget in its owner's play hand. Controller Reaction: Boot the Fix-it Shop when one of your goods is being aced to place the Gadget in its owner's Discard pile.

name: Bomb
text: Noon: Boot this dude and leave the Bomb on this deed. Any dude may, as a Noon job, ace this card. If the bomb is still on the deed after nightfall, the deed is aced.

name: Dr. Reginald Branson
text: Reaction Pull: Boot Dr. Branson when a Dude is aced in a shootout where the difference in hand ranks was less than 2 ranks, and you have at least one other Dude at the shootout location. If the pull is less than the Dude's value, the Dude is not aced but goes home booted.

name: Equipment Shop
text: Controller: All of your strikes produce 1 extra ghost rock.

name: Ezzie
text: Harrowed. Harlot. Noon: Boot Ezzie and target a Dude. The Dude's controller makes three pulls: if all three pulls are higher than the Dude's value, ace the Dude. If the Dude's controller cannot make three pulls, any pulls the controller cannot make are considered successful for Ezzie.

name: Flamethrower
text: Weapon. Gadget Difficulty: 5. If this Dude is aced in a shootout, pull: If the pull is odd, the Flamethrower explodes, acing two additional Dudes of your choice in your posse. Shootout: Pay 1 ghost rock. This Dude gains a +2 Bullet bonus and is a Stud until the end of the shootout. This action can be used once per shootout.

name: Friends in High Places
text: Noon: Boot one or more of your dudes who have a combined influence greater than the number of Control Points provided by the deed they are in. You control this deed until after nightfall, regardless of other Player's influence totals.

name: Gatling Gun
text: This Gatling Gun cannot be used when this dude has moved to a different location this turn.

name: Gerald Klippstein
text: Shootout: Boot Gerald to move him and any of your Dudes at his location into a shootout and join either posse. You can only use this action if the player controlling the posse agrees.

name: Get a Rope
text: Cheatin'! Reaction: Play this card when another player reveals an illegal Draw Hand. Boot one of your dudes and call out any one of that Player's dudes for a Shootout. This Shootout cannot be refused, and no other dudes can join the Shootout. Any actions or effects being resolved are suspended in mid-action. Only one Cheatin! Card can be played against a player per draw.

name: Get on Your Feet!
text: Noon Pull: target a booted dude. If the pull is equal to or greater than the value of the targeted dude, unboot the dude. Only one Get on Your Feet can be played per turn by each player.

name: Gordo Andrade
text: Gordo may use a second weapon during a Shootout.

name: Government Audit
text: At the end of the Upkeep Phase this turn, all players must pay 1 ghost rock for each Deed they control, up to the total ghost rock in their Vault.

name: Gunther Hapworth
text: Noon: Boot Gunther at any location and pay 1 Ghost Rock. Give him a +3 Bullet Stud bonus until the end of next turn that is in effect whenever he is at a location you control.

name: Hell's End Mine
text: Private. Strike.

name: Holy Wheel Gun
text: Mystical. Weapon. Gadget Difficulty: 6. If you ace a Harrowed dude in a Shootout with the Holy Wheel Gun, they are aced as if they were not harrowed. Noon: Boot this dude to ace a Terror at this location.

name: Howard Findley
text: While you have Howard Findley in play, your strikes cost 1 less ghost rock to put into play and they produce 1 additional ghost rock per turn.

name: Ignacio's Exotics
text: All Mystical goods you bring into play cost 2 less ghost rock.

name: It Was A Mountain Lion
text: Pull: The Dude (or Dudes) in play whose value is closest to the pull gets aced. Ace this card.

name: Jailbreak
text: Noon Job: Boot one of your dudes and gather a posse of at least one other dude to damage a deed. If the job is successful, the deed is worth 1 fewer Control Point, produces 2 fewer ghost rock per turn, and loses any special actions (minimum zero for each). These changes are permanent.

name: Jim MacNeil
text: Shootout: Boot MacNeil to replace any Sweetrock dude in a Shootout.

name: Judge Henry Warwick
text: Noon Job: Boot Warwick to assemble a posse to ace any Wanted dude in play.

name: One Eyed Ike's Weapons Locker
text: A dude occupying Ike's can only be called out by Harrowed dudes Weapons the Controller is bringing into play have their cost reduced by two.

name: Orphanage
text: Controller Reaction: Boot the Orphanage at the beginning of the upkeep phase o double the ghost rock production of one strike deed this turn (after other bonuses).

name: Overtime
text: Reaction: Play before the upkeep phase to increase the ghost rock production of all your ghost rock - producing deeds by one. On your next turn, you gain no ghost rock from your deeds.

name: Pinned Down
text: Shootout: Target a booted Dude in the opposing posse. Until the shootout ends, the target cannot be the shooter if another Dude can be, and the target's Bullet rating does not contribute to the number of cards drawn or redrawn by the opposing player.

name: Pistol Whip
text: Shootout: Target a Dude in the opposing posse. Boot one of your Dudes in this shootout to pistol whip the target Dude, who is sent home booted. Your Dude has a -1 Bullet penalty (minimum 0) until the end of the shootout.

name: Red Hill Hotel
text: Public. Controller Reaction: Immediately after the start of the Upkeep Phase, target a Dude you control. Boot the Red Hill Hotel to reduce the Dude's Upkeep cost to 0 until after Nightfall.

name: Refuse to Fall
text: Reaction: Play when the last Dude in your posse is aced in a shootout, and that Dude has Influence greater than 0. Reduce the Dude's Influence by 1 permanently. The Dude is not aced in this round. Ace the Dude after the shootout.

name: Reverend Simon MacPherson
text: Harrowed dudes may not call MacPherson out. Shootout: Boot MacPherson to reduce the Bullet Rating of all Terrors in this Shootout to zero.

name: Robert Northrop
text: Any strike where Northrop is present doubles its normal ghost rock production.

name: Rooftop Sniper
text: Shootout: Before this Shootout continues, there is a Shootout between one of your unbooted dude who is adjacent but not in the Shootout and any one enemy dude who is in this Shootout. No other dudes may enter this new Shootout.

name: Scooter's Lift Winch
text: The ghost rock cost of the Lift Winch is reduced to zero if you have Scooter in play. The Lift Winch is considered adjacent to any deed with a Winch token. Controller Noon: Boot the Lift Winch and pay 2 ghost rock to place a Winch token on an out of town deed you own.

name: Sir Whitmore
text: Noon: Boot Sir Whitmore and pay 1 ghost rock to look at a Player's Play Hand.

name: Smiley's Shaft
text: Private. Strike.

name: Sweetrock
text: GR: 20 You cannot put into play or take control of a Dude from another Outfit if you already control a non-Sweetrock, non-Drifter Dude. You have +1 Control Point for each Strike that you control that has a current Production more than 5. When playing lowball during the Gambling Phase, draw an extra card, then discard a card.

name: The Docks
text: Private. If you have Big Jake in play, reduce the ghost rock cost of The Docks by 2. The Docks Production is equal to the number of Strikes in play.

name: The Fair Comes to Town
text: Every dude with influence greater than one is booted. Ace this card.

name: The Good Doctor
text: Controller Reaction: Boot the Doctor when a dude has just been aced, and pay 2 ghost rock, and Pull: Odd means the dude does not get aced and is sent home booted instead. Even or face card means he is aced normally. Joker mean he is Harrowed and sent home booted.

name: The Temperance Army
text: Boot all saloons and brothels. These deeds do not produce ghost rock this turn and may not produce any actions.

name: The Twitch
text: If The Twitch is aced during a shootout, send him home booted instead of to Boot Hill, and permanently reduce his printed Bullet rating by 1. If his printed Bullet rating is ever permanently reduced to 0, The Twitch is removed from play and cannot return.

name: Tom O'Reilly
text: Tom's upkeep is reduced by one for every dude in Boot Hill.

name: Top of the World Lode
text: Private. Strike.

name: All Saints Day
text: Every player with one or more Blessed in play can get any one Miracle from his or her deck, show it to the other players, and put it into his or her Play hand. All decks are reshuffled. Ace this card

name: Avarice
text: Any location with Avarice in it has it's printed ghost rock production doubled. Noon: Boot Avarice to get any strike from your deck. Show it to the other players and place it in your hand. Shuffle your deck. Discard a card from your hand.

name: Between the Shoulderblades
text: Reaction: Play this card when a Dude is leaving a shootout due to a card effect of his controller. Ace that Dude.

name: Buckets Nelson
text: Experienced. Shootout: If Buckets is at a shootout and out of town, you can discard a card from your hand to create one Shark in Nelson's posse. The Shark is a non-unique, 1-Stud, 0 Influence, ace value Dude. Sharks are removed from play after the Shootout. Nelson can perform this action any number of times per turn.

name: Burial Ground
text: Out of Town. The Burial Ground is worth +1 Control Points if controlled by a Sioux player. Hexes and Miracles have their Difficulty raised by 4 when performed by a Dude at this location, and Spirits have their difficulty lowered by 2 when performed by a Dude at this location.

name: Bushwacked
text: Noon: Boot one of your Dudes to bushwhack another player’s booted Dude at the same location. Each Dude’s controller pulls. The Dude whose Bullet rating plus pull is lower is aced. If there is a tie, there is no effect. Your Dude becomes Wanted.

name: California Queen
text: River Boat. Casino. Saloon. Out of Town. Public. This Deed is considered adjacent to all Strikes in play. Any Dude not controlled by the California Queen's owner who moves to the Queen must pay 1 Ghost Rock to the Queen's owner.

name: Danny Hamilton
text: Experienced. Noon: Move any Texas Ranger to a location with a Terror in it if the Terror is in Hamilton's location or an adjacent location.

name: Demon's Eye
text: Noon Hex 7: If this Hex is successful, discard any or all card in your hand. Noon Hex 10: Boot this Huckster. If this Hex is successful, discard any or all cards in your hand and draw up to your maximum hand size.

name: Dolores Whateley
text: Experienced. Shootout:  If Dolores is at the Whateley Family Estate or a location with "Graveyard" or "Undertaker" in the title, discard any number of black cards from your hand. Each card discarded in this fashion creates one Skeleton - a 2 Stud, 0 Influence, ace value Dude - in this shootout. Skeletons are removed from play after the shootout.

name: Elijah
text: Experienced. Terrors cannot call out Elijah. Noon: Take a Miracle from another of your Dudes and attach it to Elijah. Reaction: When you attach a Miracle to Elijah, draw a card from your deck and add it to your hand.

name: Envy
text: Shootout: Target one dude. That dude may not be the shooter during this Shootout, if another dude is available.

name: Flim
text: Abomination. No Goods. Flim has no upkeep when he is adjacent to Elijah. Shootout: Ace any one dude in the opposing posse with a value lower than Flim's bullet rating.

name: Gerald Klippstein
text: Experienced. Shootout: Boot Klippstein to move him and any of your Dudes at his location into the shootout's location and join them with either posse.  Noon: Move Klippstein to another location.

name: Ghost Rock Detector
text: Gadget Difficulty: 5. Noon: Discard the Detector to go through your deck, retrieve any one Strike, and immediately put it into play. The cost of the Strike is reduced by 4 Ghost Rock. Pay all other costs normally.

name: Gluttony
text: All Goods being attached to Gluttony have their costs reduced by two. Goods cannot be moved off of Gluttony without a card effect.

name: Hell's Comin' With Me
text: Reaction: Play this card when one of your Dudes is aced during a shootout. Target one of your Dudes who, until after Nightfall, gains a +2 Bullet bonus and becomes a Stud.

name: Jim MacNeil
text: Experienced. Noon:  MacNeil can call out any Dude who has called out a Sweetrock Dude this turn or last turn, if that Dude is in MacNeil's location or an adjacent location.

name: Nate Hunter
text: Experienced. Sheriff of Gomorra.  Noon: Nate can call out any Wanted Dude in his location or an adjacent location. If the Wanted Dude does not accept the challenge, that Dude goes to his or her owner's discard pile.

name: Pride
text: Pride will not leave a Shootout without a card effect.

name: Rachel Sumner
text: Experienced. Noon:  Rachel can call out any Law Dog in her location or an adjacent location. Rachel becomes Wanted.

name: Takin' Precautions
text: Reaction:  Play this card immediately after an Event or action has completely resolved. That card and this one are both aced. This Action has no Ghost Rock cost for a Sweetrock player.

name: The Ghost
text: Experienced. Harrowed. Reaction: When The Ghost is aced and making his Harrowed pull, he goes home without booting unless you pull an ace.  Noon: Boot The Ghost to gain 3 Ghost Rock

name: Tioga Joe
text: Experienced. Other players cannot target Joe with Action cards.

name: Unlucky Charm
text: Shootout: Target a Dude in this shootout. No card effect can prevent that Dude from being aced in this shootout. Any card effect that would prevent that Dude fom being aced is negated.

name: Wrath
text: Reaction: Cancel any one Shootout action card played during a Shootout with Wrath in the Shootout.

name: Corky Hendricks
text: Experienced. Shootout: Ace Corky. Your Draw hand for this round is considered two ranks higher than your actual draw. It is considered the worst possible hand of that rank.

name: Eddie Bellows
text: Experienced. Eddie Bellows can boot to join a shootout even if he's not adjacent to the shootout's location.

name: Air Gun
text: Gadget Difficulty 6. This dude does not become Wanted for joining a posse at another player's private location.

name: Becky Henrick
text: Shootout: Boot Becky to banish any one Harrowed dude from this location. The Harrowed dude's controller must move the dude to another location he or she controls. Noon: Boot Becky and pay 2 ghost rock to control any Harrowed dude in the same location. Return control of the dude after nightfall.

name: Buffalo Rifle
text: If this dude is adjacent to the location of a job or Shootout, he or she can become part of the posse without moving or booting, even if booted. If a dude joins a posse this way, that dude cannot have any other Weapons ready until after the shootout.

name: Bum Rush
text: Shootout: Target one of your Dudes in this shootout. The Dude gains a +1 Bullet bonus until the end of the shootout. Only one Bum Rush can be played per shootout.

name: Burn 'em Down
text: Shootout: Target a Dude in the opposing posse. Boot one of your Dudes in this shootout to reduce the targets Bullet rating by an amount equal to your Dude's Bullet rating until the end of the shootout.

name: Buster Madison
text: Noon: Boot Buster at a Saloon to produce 1 Ghost Rock.

name: Captain Sim Yut-San
text: Immediately after you move Captain Sim, move any of your other Maze Rats from the Location Sim started his move to his present location. This does not boot the other dudes.

name: Chinese Day Laborers
text: This action is free for the Maze Rats. Reaction: Play immediately before you put a deed into play. That deed has its cost reduced by two.

name: Church Raisin'
text: Noon Job: Boot one of your dudes and move him to the Town Square. If the job is successful and the total influence of the dudes in your posse is greater than half the current Fear Level, then the Fear Level is reduced by one.

name: Coleman is Killed!
text: All Wanted dudes in play become unwanted. J.P. Coleman is aced, if he is in play.

name: Crippled
text: Reaction: Play immediately before a dude is going to be aced during a Shootout. Instead of being aced, that dude is sent home, but is crippled permanently. The crippled dude loses 1 Bullet, 1 Influence, and can only move to adjacent locations.

name: Election Day
text: All Dudes in play are up for the office of Mayor. Each player, as a Noon action, may boot a Dude to give any candidate votes equal to the dude's Influence, or else pay three ghost rock to buy one vote for any dude. If at nightfall any Dude has more votes than everyone else, he or she gains one Influence and becomes worth an extra Control Point, until the next Election Day. Ace this card.

name: Finnegan O'Malley
text: If a posse with O'Malley wins a round of a Shootout, the opposing posse must ace one additional dude.

name: Green-Eye Saloon
text: Public. Nonunique. Saloon

name: Gyonshee
text: Abomination. Cannot move to a location that does not have a Maze Rat.

name: Howlin' Hollow
text: Private. Strike. Haunted. Controller Noon: Target a Harrowed Dude. Boot the Howlin' Hollow to give the Dude a +1 Bullet bonus until after Nightfall.

name: Hunch
text: Noon Hex X: Boot this Huckster. The difficulty of this Hex is double the number of cards you want to look at. If this Hex is successful, look at the top X cards of any player's deck. You may put one of those cards on the bottom of the deck or the top of the discard pile.

name: Kidnapping
text: Noon Job: Boot one of your Dudes to start a job that targets another player's Dude. The target must have a lower Bullet rating than your Dude. If the job succeeds, the target Dude is discarded (if still in play), and all Dudes in your posse become Wanted.

name: Library
text: All Hucksters in the controller's gang have +1 Bullet bonus and +1 Influence.

name: Long Arm of the Law
text: Boot all Wanted dudes in play.

name: Luck of the Draw
text: Reaction: Play immediately before Draw Hands are revealed to increase or decrease your hand rank by one (and your hand is now considered the worst possible hand of that rank).

name: Maze Dragon
text: Abomination. May not have goods. The Maze Dragon cannot move to or join posses at locations in town.

name: Maze Runner
text: All strikes are considered adjacent for this dude. Noon: Boot the Maze Runner to move this dude and up to four of your other dudes from one strike to another.

name: Mitobu
text: Shootout: Ace any Abomination in the opposing posse. Mitobu cannot be your shooter and provides no Bullet bonus in this shootout. You cannot perform this action if Mitobu is the only dude in your posse.

name: Mortimer Jones
text: It costs 3 less ghost rock to bring Jones into play if you control the Rail Station. Reaction: Boot Jones to reduce by 2 ghost rock the cost of a dude or goods you are about to bring into play.

name: Mustang
text: Horse. Reaction: Boot the Mustang instead of this dude when joining a posse. A booted dude cannot join in this fashion.

name: Nelson Roberts
text: Roberts can attach any card with "Rifle" in the title at no cost.

name: Night Haunt
text: Reaction Pull: Play immediately before the end of nightfall when a dude is at a strike or other out-of-town location. If the pull is greater than the dude's value, he is aced. This action cannot target a Terror, Reverend or member of the Flock.

name: No Funny Stuff
text: Shootout: No Reactions except Cheatin' cards can be played until after this shootout. No more Shootout actions can be played during this shootout.

name: Phantom Fingers
text: Noon Hex 7: If this Hex is successful, take any one goods on a Dude in an adjacent location and give it to the Huckster if she can hold it. Shootout Hex 8: If this Hex is successful, take any one weapon attached to opposing Dude and give it to this Huckster if she can hold it.

name: Rain Dance
text: Reaction Spirit 5: Boot this shaman during upkeep. If the Spirit is successful, your Outfit's ghost rock production is increased by three for this turn.

name: Red Spade
text: Reaction: Play immediately after a Pull is revealed to change the suit or color of the pull to the suit or color of your choice.

name: Richard Boothe
text: While Boothe is at another player's strike, it produces no ghost rock.

name: Sacred Tomahawk
text: Mystical. May only be attached to a Sioux. Shootout: Ace the Tomahawk to ace any opposing Harrowed Dude.

name: Smiling Lizard Lode
text: Private. Strike. Non-Terror Dude's have a -1 Bullet penalty while in a shootout at this location.

name: Speed of the Wolf
text: Noon Spirit 5: Target one of your unbooted Dudes. If this Spirit succeeds, move the Dude to any location in play. Reaction Spirit 7: Call this Spirit when a posse is being formed. Target one of your unbooted Dudes. If this Spirit succeeds, the Dude joins the posse, regardless of his or her location

name: Stampede
text: Every Dude in the Town Square is moved home booted. No Dudes can move to the Town Square this turn.

name: Sun Shu-Jen
text: May not have any weapons. Shootout: Shu-Jen gains a +2 Bullet bonus if there are no weapons in the opposing posse. Shootout: Send home all dudes in the opposing posse with a value lower than Shu-Jen's Bullet Rating.

name: Tattoo
text: Noon: Boot one of your Sioux dudes. This dude takes a -1 Bullet penalty(minimum zero), permanently. This dude has his Shaman skill increased by one, permanently. No dude may be tattooed more than once during a game. This does not give the Shaman skill to a dude that does not have it.

name: The Fear
text: Noon: If the Fear Level is 5 or greater, boot all non-Terror dudes with a Bullet Rating less than 2.

name: The Maze Rats
text: GR: 16 Your dudes may consider all strikes to be adjacent to your home. Noon: Boot one or more of your dudes at a strike you control. If the combined bullet rating of the dudes is higher than the production of the strike, you are considered the owner of the deed until the end of the game.

name: Wall Crawler
text: Abomination. The Wall Crawler cannot move to locations in town. The Wall Crawler cannot attach Goods. There is no limit to the number of Wall Crawlers that each player can have in play. Card Memory does not apply to Wall Crawlers.

name: Xiong "Wendy" Cheng
text: Shootout: Target a Dude in the opposing posse and send the Dude home booted. Wendy has a -2 Bullet penalty (minimum 0) and becomes a Draw until after Nightfall.

name: Ambition
text: Noon Harrowed Power: Target one of your unbooted Harrowed Dudes. Until the end of the game, the Dude has the ability "Shootout: Boot this Dude to move this Dude to the shootout's location and join your posse." Ace this card.

name: Corky's Sidearm
text: Unique. Weapon. Can only be attached to a Law Dog Dude. This Dude gains +1 Bullet bonus and a +1 Influence bonus for every other Law Dog Dude in this location.

name: Dragon's Claw
text: Unique. Weapon. Can only be attached to a Maze Rat Dude. This Dude gains +1 Bullet bonus and a +1 Influence bonus for every other Maze Rat Dude in this location.

name: Electrothermic Entropy Projector
text: Unique. Weapon. Gadget. Can only be attached to a Collegium Dude. This Dude gains +1 Bullet bonus and a +1 Influence bonus for every other Collegium Dude in this location. When bringing this Gadget into play, it can be attached to Dudes other than Mad Scientists, and does not require a skill check.

name: Flamethrower
text: Weapon. Gadget Difficulty: 5. If this Dude is aced in a shootout, pull: If the pull is odd, the Flamethrower explodes, acing two additional Dudes of your choice in your posse. Shootout: Pay 1 ghost rock. This Dude gains a +2 Bullet bonus and is a Stud until the end of the shootout. This action can be used once per shootout.

name: Flaming Barrels
text: Shootout: Target a Dude with a ready Weapon in your posse. The Dude gains a +2 Bullet bonus until the end of the shootout.

name: Frank
text: Unique. Weapon. Can only be attached to a Texas Ranger Dude. This Dude gains +1 Bullet bonus and a +1 Influence bonus for every other Texas Ranger Dude in this location.

name: Mr. Prim's Bust
text: Unique. Weapon. Can only be attached to a Sweetrock Dude. This Dude gains +1 Bullet bonus and a +1 Influence bonus for every other Sweetrock Dude in this location.

name: Pinned Down
text: Shootout: Target a booted Dude in the opposing posse. Until the shootout ends, the target cannot be the shooter if another Dude can be, and the target's Bullet rating does not contribute to the number of cards drawn or redrawn by the opposing player.

name: Rachel's Sidearm
text: Unique. Weapon. Can only be attached to a Black Jack Dude. This Dude gains +1 Bullet bonus and a +1 Influence bonus for every other Black Jack Dude in this location.

name: Raven's Chop
text: Unique. Weapon. Can only be attached to a Sioux Union Dude. This Dude gains +1 Bullet bonus and a +1 Influence bonus for every other Texas Ranger Dude in this location.

name: Sister Mary's Shotgun
text: Unique. Weapon. Can only be attached to an Agency Dude. This Dude gains +1 Bullet bonus and a +1 Influence bonus for every other Agency Dude in this location.

name: The Hooded Figure's Scythe
text: Unique. Weapon. Can only be attached to a Whateley Dude. This Dude gains +1 Bullet bonus and a +1 Influence bonus for every other Whateley Dude in this location.
